reviews.text: We really enjoyed our experience here! If you’re looking for a place with good seating, views, and traditional food, come here. We fully embraced the experience and had an awesome time. The servers are kind, will explain things in english (or at least try to!) and the menu is also in English and Romanian. They have the story of the establishment in the menu, which we liked reading about. The seating is SO CUTE. They had indoor seating but who wants that? Pick outdoor! They had heating lamps and blankets and SO many adorable cats! Make sure to give the cats a little bite of your food if you can. The drinks were good, and we enjoyed trying the traditional food, which was very flavorful. Overall, we would be back!

This restaurant appears to cater primarily to tourists seeking a novelty experience rather than quality dining.
The food was clearly pre-prepared and arrived at the table lukewarm. We ordered our meals at the same time as a bottle of wine, and the dishes were served within approximately three minutes — effectively at the same moment the wine was poured. This timing strongly suggests the meals were not prepared to order.
Given the pricing, the quality was disappointing. The dishes resembled reheated, mass-produced fare lacking freshness, flavor, or distinction.
The live band and dancers provided entertainment, though the performance felt routine and mechanical, as if repeated nightly without much enthusiasm.
Service was inconsistent. Our waitress was largely unavailable during the meal and slow to respond when needed. At payment, however, she became quite assertive — insisting on a specific minimum tip amount. This was particularly uncomfortable given that communication was limited, as she spoke no English in what is clearly a tourist-oriented establishment.
Overall, the experience did not justify the cost. Unless one’s goal is simply to check off a themed dining experience regardless of food quality or service standards, there are likely far better options available.

Hanu’ lui Manuc is a charming and atmospheric place to experience traditional Romanian cuisine, especially if you enjoy historic settings with character and local flavor. The restaurant has a unique ambiance that reflects the cultural heritage of the area, making it an appealing spot for both tourists and locals who want an authentic dining experience.

However, our visit started with a small disappointment. Despite having a reservation, we were redirected to a different table than expected, which felt a bit unprofessional and took away from the initial impression. Additionally, the Greek salad was quite underwhelming and did not live up to its name or typical flavor profile.

On a more positive note, the main dishes were much more satisfying. The lamb stew was very well prepared, rich in flavor, and perfectly balanced in texture and seasoning. The Angus burger was another highlight — juicy, flavorful, and cooked just right, making it a great option even if you’re not in the mood for traditional dishes.

A special mention goes to our waiter, who was extremely helpful, attentive, and polite. His friendly attitude and willingness to assist significantly improved our overall experience and made us feel welcome despite the earlier inconvenience.

MRS MARIA is best to make our dinner
thank you to her

In general, Hanu’ lui Manuc is a good choice if you want to explore Romanian cuisine in a historic and authentic environment. With some improvements in reservation handling and consistency in certain dishes, it has the potential to offer an even better dining experience.

The food was absolutely delicious from start to finish. Every dish was full of flavor, beautifully presented, and clearly made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. You can really taste the care and attention that goes into the cooking — everything was perfectly prepared and exceeded our expectations.

The service made the experience even better. Our waitress, Iulia Dorobantu, was incredibly lovely, friendly, and attentive throughout the entire meal. She made us feel welcome right away, checked in at just the right moments, and had such a positive, professional attitude. Her warm personality truly added to the atmosphere and made our visit extra enjoyable.

Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience with fantastic food and outstanding service. We’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend this place to others!

I was told that this is the best place to eat in the old town. The restaurant is huge, and you can see the personnel constantly passing by.

As for the food, the Caesar salad was the worst salad I have ever tasted in my life. Lemon and fish were mixed with the ingredients of the Caesar salad, which completely ruined it. The lamb was tasty but served at room temperature — it should have been at least warm.

I read the reviews to understand why the rating is so high, but I’m sorry to disappoint you — this place deserves a maximum of 3.

Haute Pepper is an essential destination for anyone in the area. From the moment you enter, you’re welcomed by a team of genuinely friendly staff. The ambiance is both exceptional and inviting, setting the stage for a memorable meal.

Each dish is crafted with evident care, delivering remarkable flavor in every bite. We enjoyed the Chicken Supreme, accompanied by velvety mashed sweet potatoes and perfectly seasoned vegetables. The American Cheeseburger was another standout, juicy and satisfying, served with a generous portion of golden, crisp fries.

For dessert, the cheesecake and the lemon tart with forest fruits were delightful. Each tasted wonderfully fresh and had that unmistakable, quality touch of being made in house.

A special thanks to our waiter, Julian, who ensured every detail of our visit felt special. We truly cannot recommend Haute Pepper enough!

Oh my goodness, this is a hidden gem. If you visit Bucharest you must come here.  The food is 10/10 the staff are so attentive, and the atmosphere is Atmosphere is a chilled vibe.  We shall definitely come again.

Haute Pepper: A Hidden Flame Near Constitution Circle.

At first glance, Haute Pepper does not announce itself. The building blends in like a quiet residential home near Constitution Square, modest and unassuming, as if daring you to walk past without a second look. But once you step inside, the story changes.
Light floods the space generously, pouring through wide windows and dancing across tasteful décor that feels both modern and warm. The restaurant breathes alive with calm elegance rather than loud pretension.

Julian, initially reserved, slowly transforms into the soul of hospitality once the conversation begins. His cooperative warmth becomes the invisible seasoning that elevates the entire experience.
Then comes the food and with it, drama of the finest kind.

The pork chop with mushroom sauce arrives like a hero in a well-timed entrance: succulent, tender, cooked to absolute perfection. Each bite releases a rich, earthy harmony between meat and sauce, a performance so flawless that silence naturally falls at the table.

Just when you think the evening has peaked, the lemon tart appears; bright, sharp, elegant. It slices through the richness of the meal like a spotlight in the dark, the perfect final act. Truly, the icing on the cake.

All in all, Haute Pepper is a hidden flame in the quiet lanes near Constitution Circle — subtle on the outside, unforgettable within. A place you don’t just visit, but experience.

We had a great experience from start to finish. The food was delicious, made with fresh ingredients, and full of flavor. You can really taste the quality. The staff was kind, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. The atmosphere is warm and pleasant, which made the whole experience even better. We would definitely come back and highly recommend this place.

Our server TiTi? Was lovely! Very attentive. I had the prawn salad and it was very nice!
My partner had the beef pasta and the beef was not fatty, very tender

name: buoni e bravi - Piața Rosetti
address: Piața C. A. Rosetti 3, 021051 București, Romania

reviews.text: Very good pizza and definitely different from most pizzas you find around the city. I loved the variety of toppings and flavors — each slice felt unique. The central location is convenient and the staff was very friendly. Definitely worth trying.

This pizzeria offers a generally positive experience, particularly if you're looking for a quick and satisfying slice. The pizza itself is quite rich and generously topped, so much so that one slice might be all you need to feel full. While the staff is courteous, it's worth noting that the prices feel a bit high given the overall location and service. If you're in the mood for a hearty slice and don't mind spending a bit more, it's a solid option. However, be prepared for a substantial portion with each order!

Excellent! Easily the best pizza I've ever had! Great quality dough and topping, interesting recipes for various tastes. Cool music and staff, it only lacks some kind of space/hooks for luggage and cooling in the hot days.

A very delicious pizza with lots of toppings 😍
I'll gladly come back. The portions are quite big, one piece per person is enough.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Absolutely amazing pizza! I stumbled upon Buoni e Bravi while exploring the city and was blown away by the quality. The crust is thin and crispy — just like in Rome — and the ingredients taste super fresh. You can really tell they care about what they serve. The staff was friendly and quick, and the place had a cozy, authentic vibe. It’s perfect for a quick, delicious bite. Highly recommend for any pizza lover visiting Bucharest!

Good selection of vegetarian and non vegetarian food, salad and soup. The staff seemed friendly enough. Nice and clean. The loud music that was playing on the screen was very off putting and we had to hurry with our food and leave as we couldn’t stand it!
Best restaurant in Bucharest! Very varied traditional Romanian food and reasonably priced. Great service too which is rare! Highly recommend!
This is a good place to get buffet style food. I got chicken, fries and pepsi max. I paid total 33 RON. Food was delicious. Portions were large.

Good, tasty and affordable food here, choose what you want from the buffet and pay by item. Sometimes has some Asian options also, but mostly local dishes. Big variety around lunch time (hence the name), but you can still find a few options by 2pm or so. Not a fancy place, and that's great for me. Lots of locals/office workers eat here
Very good food, good portions, amazing customer service... Very happy with all the experience. I bought too much food, I think one plate with 3 options would be enough jeje.

One of the most beautiful restaurants I've ever been to. It's pricey, though, above average. They have local beer, which I really love and appreciate. Unfortunately, it was average in taste. The food was interesting and varied, mostly national dishes and meat dishes. We enjoyed it. The bread soup is especially good. We celebrated my girlfriend's birthday; we ordered three courses for two, two beers, and a wine, for a total of €60+. Our waiter also gave us a nice birthday surprise: two glasses of sparkling wine.

Despite the price, this place is a must-visit.

We had to wait 50mins in the bar area, standing and with people passing around you, just to be seated. Okay, we didnt have a reservation and is nice that they take guesys spontaneously, but I think the waiting time should be reduced, is a bit too much.
The place is clearly very touristy and they cater to tourists. Menu with english, waiters who speak english, receptionists welcome u in eng.
The building is super nice and pretty. Traditional wood and with nice painted glass.
They have their own brewed house beer, which tastes light and fresh, but not strong.
I had the Rib Eye steak, which is served with french fries, ketchup and garlic mayo? Sadly it was HORRIBLE. Rubbery, dry, disgusting. The fries were soggy and soft, as if soaked in a lot of oil for just a short period of time.
My bf got the cauliflower slice with some tomato sauce, that was ok. Some dip with chips and then some extra potatoes so he cud feel full.
Portions outside of the main meat platters are rather small.
The waiter just came to take our order and never ever came back. We had to order the extra potatoes through the app as he was never around the area.
But of course, when paying, he asked if we wanted to leave tip, suggesting the tip percentages written in the bill. That would be ok if you actually did your job, but when taken for granted and still demanding it at the end, definitely not correct.
The place also had a nice show with 2 couples of dancers who did Latino rythms and classical dancing, then other 2 couples who did Romanian traditional dancing. Both the groups in all rythms invited guests to dance with them and the environment was super fun due to it. They saved the night for us, to be honest.
Overall, crowded, touristy, and in my opinion, you can eat better for more affoedable prices in Bucharest.

Caru’ cu Bere is a fantastic choice for dinner right in the heart of Bucharest. The menu offers a wide variety of meat dishes, all well prepared and full of flavor, perfectly complemented by an impressive selection of wines to suit different tastes.

What truly sets this place apart is its traditional Romanian ambience—beautiful historic interiors, lively atmosphere, and a strong sense of local culture. The experience is made even more special with live performances, which add energy and authenticity to the evening without overwhelming the dining experience. Overall, it’s an excellent spot to enjoy great food, good wine, and a memorable cultural dinner in Bucharest

First of all, we made a reservation a few days in advance in order to sit on the balcony. Finding a reservation—especially on the balcony and after 7:00 PM—is quite difficult, as the traditional dance show starts at 7:30 PM. Unfortunately, we couldn’t catch the show, but the atmosphere was wonderful.

The waiters and all the staff were very polite. Andreea took care of us, and she was extremely kind and attentive.

As for the food, we started with the pumpkin soup. It was good, but if I go again, I probably wouldn’t choose it. For the main course, we ordered the mixed grill, which was more than sufficient for two people. It included two different sausages, two mici, one piece of chicken breast, and one piece of pork. My favorites were the cheese-filled sausage and the mici.

We also tried their traditional drink. For dessert, we chose sour cherry sauce and blueberry sauce—the blueberry one was my favorite.

Overall, we left very happy and satisfied. 😊

I had a wonderful experience at Caru' cu Bere. The cuisine is authentic, rich in tradition, and full of original flavors. Every dish was beautifully prepared and packed with taste — you can truly feel the passion behind the recipes. The menu offers a great variety of Romanian specialties, each one more delicious than the last.

One of the highlights of my meal was the roasted lamb shank served with creamy mashed potatoes and fresh vegetables. The meat was incredibly tender, perfectly cooked, and full of deep, rich flavor. It practically fell off the bone and paired beautifully with the smooth, buttery mash. The combination of textures and flavors made this dish absolutely unforgettable.

The atmosphere is warm and lively, which makes the whole experience even more memorable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking to discover genuine, flavorful Romanian cuisine in a charming setting.

★★★★★
We are currently staying at Edison Blue in Bucharest, and we’re genuinely impressed by the level of care and professionalism throughout the hotel.

First of all, a big thank you to the hotel management and the entire team, especially the staff at the reception and information desk — they respond quickly, handle any request with ease, and always do it in a friendly, respectful way. The hotel is clean, well organized, and the spa is absolutely amazing — a perfect place to truly relax.

And a special thank you to the Business Lounge, especially Claudia. Today she made our visit feel truly special — warm attention, great service, and beautifully prepared pancakes served with real care and detail. That kind of hospitality stays with you.

Thank you again to everyone at Edison Blue for creating such a welcoming experience. Highly recommended.

I am currently staying in Bucharest at the Raddison Blu, and the experience has been fantastic. I was meant to be staying on a local Airbnb but had to leave due to cleanliness. I went to the Raddison and the team were brilliant. Aysha is a credit to the organisation. She was polite, friendly and pressional. She is the exact person you want to encounter when staying on a hotel. Her customer service skills are to be commended.

One of the best stays I’ve ever had at Radisson. As a VIP guest, I was upgraded to a renovated two-level room, which made the experience even more special.

The breakfasts were excellent, with a great variety and quality. The hotel features an outdoor pool shared between Radisson Blu and Park Inn, which is a lovely bonus. There’s also a fitness center and an indoor pool connected to the hotels, both complimentary for guests.

Additionally, the minibar is included once per stay, which is a nice extra touch.

Me and my girlfriend stayed in Radisson Blu Bucharest from the 23rd to the 26th of January. It was such an amazing experience from all points of view. All the staff members went anice and beyond to make our stay seamless. At the check-in we were welcomed by Valentina that has quickly registeres us and provided all the information, she was great and helped us during our stay for everything we needed. I would also like to mention the night manager Eric and the receptionist Alina who helped us to confirm a late check out during our last day (we had a late flight). Thanks a lot.

The executive lounge in the hotel is really amazing and there are exceptional people working there. In particular one staff member stands out, Marius, a very professional employee that was very kind with us and also spoke italian, he made us feel like at home.

If you are a fit person there is a gym fully equipped with a internal pool and you can also relax inside an amazing esternal heated pool with jacuzzi.

The cherry on top was the Thai SPA, were we had a couple massage on the last day. The SPA is really great, equipped with everything you may need, very clean and there are very professional therapists there. I strongly suggest reserving a massage during your visit.

Finally, everything about the hotel is 5 out of 5 stars: nice rooms, professional staff, great guest experience, great location. I strongly reccomend staying here if you will visit Bucharest!

We had a wonderful stay at Radisson Blu Hotel Bucharest, and we truly can’t recommend it enough.

From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding — professional, warm, and attentive to every detail. The rooms were spotless, beautifully maintained, and extremely comfortable, which made our stay even more enjoyable and relaxing.

A special and heartfelt thank you goes to Madalina Agiu, Lobby Duty Manager, who went above and beyond to make our experience exceptional. Madalina assisted us with everything we needed, always with patience, kindness, and a genuine desire to help. Her service was not only efficient but also incredibly caring and personal, and it truly made a difference in our stay.

It’s rare to encounter such a high level of hospitality, and thanks to the excellent team — especially Madalina — our stay was memorable in the best possible way.

Highly recommended, and we would happily return again!

Excellent restaurant!
We ate many dishes there and they were all really tasty.
The service we received was wonderful.
We will come back again of course.

Alin hosted us perfectly!
Everything we ordered was delicious. We were 5 men, ate to our FULL, including a round of beer and soft drinks, paid 200 euro after a 15% tip.
Highly recommended

Georgiana was very quick to answer and friendly. Helped us with recommendations and was thoughtful!
It was our first time trying Papanasi and it was delightful.
The meat was very tasty, seasoned and cooked perfectly!

We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The cuisine was truly excellent — every dish was beautifully presented, full of flavor, and prepared with high-quality ingredients. You can really taste the attention to detail and care in the cooking. The menu offers a great variety, and everything we tried was fresh and perfectly balanced.

The atmosphere is warm, elegant, and very welcoming, making it an ideal place to relax and enjoy a great meal. The ambiance adds a special touch to the overall dining experience.

A special thank you to Georgiana, who assisted us throughout the evening. She was professional, attentive, and genuinely kind. Her recommendations were spot-on, and she made us feel comfortable and well taken care of from start to finish.

We highly recommend this restaurant and look forward to coming back.

Decent restaurant located in the South East corner of Old Town Bucharest (near Piata Sfantul Anton). Visited for lunch, no reservation needed. Recommend you sit upstairs (roomy, more intimate). Entrance level is noisy, cafeteria vibe and smoky. Ordered: Veal schnitzel (overcooked, tough and cost 99 lei!) served with a tiny bit of lettuce. Sides: Fries (served cold) and Tomato and cucumber salad (passable). Cold draught beer served. Staff were very friendly and efficient. Only two toilets upstairs (not discreet - you can hear the hand dryer in the restaurant). Settled bill via credit card.

Super nice place with a lovely wine selection and delicious food! The White wine tasting (3x) was nice, and afterwards I asked what wine the server would recommend, and she proposed a very interesting wine, which I really enjoyed. The vegetation platter for two was delicious!
I highly recommend, and would love to come back again.
We bought the wine tasting for two, two extra glasses of wine, the vegetarian platter, and a slice of pie. The price was around 360 lei in total.
The pizza was absolutely delicious! The staff were very polite and friendly, and the atmosphere was quiet and romantic. I would definitely recommend it!
The food is good, but given the prices, I can't rate it as a 5* location. For such prices I expect a great experience, not an average one. Nice Christmasy decor though 💪🏼

Best pizza in town 🍕
And good selection of Romanian wines 🍷

Went here on a cold night in January. The kitchen is open until 22:30.
Thus, when I visited, it was at ≈30% capacity.
The staff is great.
Service is very quick.
The beef pie is amazing.
The platters are amazing.
Definitely will return!

name: Wok pe Loc
address: Bulevardul Ion C. Brătianu 44, 030167 București, Romania

reviews.text:
Cant give enough stars to this place. The service, the food, nothing i have seen before in any of my travels. The food and ordering takes some time, but thats with such a homey feeling, u dont think it takes more than a minute. The food is impeccable, a lot, and stays warm for more than 40+ minutes.
Deffenitly coming back next time in Bucharest.

grabbed a bite yesterday at around 21:00, the lady was all alone inside the shop and she was soo nice! she helped us with the menu and prepared our orders in no time. the food, as many other reviews have said, is amazing and so flavourful! definitely recommend coming here if you're near and looking for a place to eat

Prime location.
The lady is running the place alone, had so many orders yet was patient and helping with everyone.
The place had a lot of options and variety.
She has an amazing vibe, spoke English well.
The food was so delicious!!
Would visit again
Many available options, freshly made and good service. The lady preparing the food can give you quick recommendations if needed. Had rice noodles with beef and shrimp.
Amazing food! The owner prepared the dishes quickly and I truly like the concept. The food arrived in no time and the place is neat and clean. Will visit again for sure!

name: Taqueria El Torito - Mâncare Mexicană București

reviews.text:
Food: 5⭐
Everything was very good. We tried several different dishes — all fresh, delicious, and highly recommended.

Location: 5⭐
Heated terrace, cozy atmosphere. We recommend making a reservation in advance.

Staff: 1⭐
The gentleman who served us was very kind at first, until the food arrived. We were a group of 12 people, with multiple dishes ordered. Many items were mixed up, including drinks. When we tried to clarify the mistakes, he became quite rude and arrogant, blaming us for not knowing what we had ordered. That is not correct — it is the waiter’s responsibility to take the order properly. Each person ordered one main dish and one drink, so it was easy for each of us to know what we ordered.
It’s a shame, because we come to a restaurant to enjoy ourselves, not to be shouted at by the staff.

We were for lunch, no reservation in advance and we got a table for 1.5 hour, enough to enjoy our meal (I do recommend to make a reservation in advance, not to have surprises) The food is delicious, I’m not here for the first time and I have tasted various foods from the menu, all of them 5 ⭐️

PS in the past it was an incident with the service when we were a table of 12, mixed / wrong orders, extra drinks served without being ordered and then he shouted at us that we forgot what we’ve ordered, didn’t take it back, he was very rude and arrogant, same with the food.

I still go there for the food, and the service is quite nice, when small groups.

Plate for 2 was good, especially the taquittos. Had a piece of beef burrito from a friend, that was even better. But even better than the food was the mariachi band playing there. Real south-americans, speaking spanish and they made a great atmosphere. Good entertainment.
The best Mexican food place so far! Best drinks and sauces! Alambre de arrachera highly recommend! Also chipotle Mary cocktail for bloody Mary lovers) it's wonderful!

Best Mexican food in Bucharest, hands down!! The tacos were amazing and the BEST margaritas!!!! We can’t wait to go back. Every. Week. From now on! Great service, lovely atmosphere. Did I mention the TACOS?! Oh, and the TAMALES?!! And the margaritas?! 😋😋😋

I've purchased twice from this pastry shop and I am pleasantly impressed by the good product quality. The shop is very cute, the packaging as well. The cakes are made with natural ingredients, they taste good and the prices are decent (by comparison with other cake shops that use very low quality ingredients they sell at high quality prices).
I don't know if they do but I haven't seen yet that they make also other traditional cakes like for eg. Krantz, Ora12, old fashioned éclair with creme patissiere, diplomat, Cabane, Excelent, Indiene etc. (I'm a gourmand 😋).
Keep it up!

I chose this cake shop because they also make products for diabetics and I was not disappointed.
I bought one cake for diabetics (no sugar, no flour, no refined carbohydrates of any kind) and 8 diet cakes (sugar-free only). I also bought some “normal” mini-cakes, a few of each type, enough to fill a plateau (pick-up on 12.10.2024).
Everybody liked all the cakes. My diabetic relative said this was the best diabetic cake they had ever tasted.
They also have coffee, I will definitely try it next time if I have time.

I like to buy cookies from this place. They have a good variety of sweets and they are delicious. You should try the pinacolada sweets (small candys from the picture), the variety of eclair with different creams and the  chocolate cakes. Enjoy and follow up for more places to visit and eat 😊
A pleasant surprise in an overheated city. Cute designs. Cute colors. Haven't tasted yet the sweets.
Nice central cake shop with many options. Cakes are accessible and consistent, the pastry products are however overpriced. Nice that you can have the cakes at the table there.

If you like football you'll probably like this pub. There are 8 screens showing various games - 2 screens outside and 2 inside. All the seats inside are high stools, which can be angled towards whichever screen you're interested in.

The pub plays music quite loudly whilst the games are being shown, not a place for conversation really as it's hard to hear.

The bar provides table service, and has a reasonable range of drinks available - a 0.4l draught beer was around £3.
Very cool Sports bar with a dozen of big tv screens!
Fantastic sports bar, perfect for football nights and F1 Sundays!
Normal, entirely ok sports bar. Reasonable good service and prices. One issue was that the sound level was brutally high. We watched the F1 GP in Aug 2025 and left the bar with ears ringing.
Good vibe. I recommend it. Fast service, good food and affordable prices. The bartender...wow

I had the “Bors De Specla Cu Vitel” and the Bucur draft beer! Both were delicious. The pub has a very comfortable setting. Great place to have a bite to eat and something to drink. Very endearing decor.

This location is right in the center, but it's little crowded. The menu offers traditional romanian food, but the place is designed in the style of an English pub. The prices are affordable. I recommend it!

Another excellent bar in Bucharest friendly staff nice beer 🍺 in a very familiar British bar setting. Once again this bar does food including British Food, it was too early to eat. All I can say is I was made welcome and I enjoyed this bar which is right across from a really nice Orthodox Church.

We brought 30 people tonight from Bucharest Digital Nomads meet-up and Maria was there to serve us all on top of the classical customers.

Thanks to Maria's energy and amazing care we had an amazing time. Everyone was thankful.

Mulțumesc Maria !!!!

Very helpful and nice staff speaking english. The food was delicious in big portions. We were a group of 8 people and everything we ordered was very fast prepared. We tried the beer Bucur and it was very nice! Definitely recommend this place!

We had a really nice evening at the chefs table! The food was outstanding and it would really deserve a Michelin Star if the Guide ever shows up in Romania.
Razvan was an exceptional Host/sommelier and made sure that we were never thirsty!
The only thing which we would improve is that sometimes we got the wine for the next course presented while still eating and drinking which made it a bit hard to listen to what was said and enjoying the food at the same time.

We visited Kane to celebrate a birthday, and from the very first course, it was clear this was not just dinner—it was a performance in ten acts. We opted for the tasting menu, accompanied by a few signature cocktails (each one an artful balance of flavor and finesse) and their house-made cola, which was surprisingly complex and refreshing—a nostalgic sip reimagined and handmade on the spot.

Each of the ten courses carried its own story, a clear expression of the chef’s creativity and restraint. The plating was sculptural, the flavors precise, and the rhythm of the meal beautifully paced. You could sense intention in every element—textures layered like musical notes, contrasts between earthy and bright, warm and cold, smooth and crisp.

The highlight of the evening was the steak, prepared using the larding technique, where fat is carefully woven into the meat before cooking. The result was astonishing: tender yet structured, deeply flavorful, with a melt-in-your-mouth richness that lingered long after the last bite.

And then came dessert—a finale that defied expectation. It wasn’t just sweet; it was architectural, emotional, and daringly modern. A perfect close to a meal that never once lost momentum.

Kane is more than one of Bucharest’s best fine dining experiences, it’s a culinary conversation between creativity and craftsmanship, between local roots and global inspiration. Whether you’re celebrating something special or simply craving an evening where every dish surprises you, Kane delivers with precision.

A Masterclass in Gastronomy, Heritage, and Heart

We recently celebrated a family member's birthday at Kané for a Chef’s Table experience that exceeded every expectation.

This isn't just a meal; it is a deep dive into Romanian culture and flavours with a twist!

The evening was framed beautifully by Razvan, the founder, who shared fascinating insights into the restaurant's home—a Class I Cultural Heritage building - a historic landmark worth visiting right in the heart of Bucharest. Understanding the architecture and the history of the walls around us added a profound sense of place to the night. Razvan also provided a wonderful personal touch for the birthday girl, inviting our table to engage in a small game that brought so much laughter and connection to the celebration. 🥂

The culinary journey was equally mind-blowing, led by the personal intervention of Vlad Padurescu - the Head Chef and master culinary storyteller. Between his deep knowledge of geography and the stories of ingredients on their native lands, he demonstrated a masterclass in sustainability. His passion for collaborating with local suppliers from across the country is evident and delicious in every bite.

The highlights of our carefully crafted menu included:
🍄 Layered Forest: A stunning starter of truffle and chanterelle cream with porcini. The "fresh air" element was a stroke of genius that transported us straight to the mountains... without the traffic and into a wild universe of delicate yet powerful flavours.

🥩 Signature Should Stay Beef: The tens-of-layers steak was exceptional, paired creatively with roasted eggplant cream and labneh.

The teamwork we witnessed in the kitchen was fresh and seamless. The warm atmosphere made us feel like family.

If you are looking for creativity, expertise, and a true connection to Romanian soul with a twist, this is the place.

Thank you, Razvan, Chef Padurescu and the entire team, for an unforgettable birthday and dining experience!

Kané was the absolute culinary experience we were looking for. The food kept on surprising us, one dish after another.
And we had the best desert so far!
Absolutely worth it! The service was exceptional, the ambiance… everything! Glad that we could find even a reservation on shot notice!

Delight for the senses in a welcoming caring space…all given the people around and their attention to each of us. The set menu is generous and full of different flavors that can mix local ingredients with more exotic ones. An experience to enjoy in 2.

This place it's so elegant and sophisticated, amazing if you want to check something different. The stuff is very polite and helpful and the atmosphere is unique as you can delight yourself with live very well chosen musique. The food is very good and you must try also the desert. I had a very nice evening here together with my friends. I truly recommend it!

Great food, lovely atmosphere, locals enjoy this place a lot and make tourists appreciate it too! During summer, tables are arranged outside and people dance slow dances whilst sipping wine and beer! Loved it!

This is a very large restaurant, with a beautiful inerior. Very good for groups and large parties. It can accomodate easily two parties simultaneously and still haave retreats for casual clients. The food and prices are very decent, while the staff is OK.

Unable to enter. Before visiting I asked the place online if I can enter as NATO soldier, 2 different people answered yes. At the entrance I had shown my allied army ID, they said no problem, however they take cash only. I went inside, looked up the menu to know how much cash I will need and went to ATM. 15 minutes later young soldier outside did not let me in, he said only Romanian army. There was no way to explain it to him…
I never imagine that in 2019 I will eat so worst. Starters from Middle Ages, smelling fish & boiled vegetables with no taste, overcooked steaks. Conclusion is in just two words: Stay away!

name: TANO Unirii
address: Bloc 5C, Bulevardul Unirii 20, Nr. 20, Bl. 5C, 040107 București, Romania

reviews.text: Loved my visit here, it was newly opened and such a lovely welcoming place. Friendly staff, i popped in for a glass of wine while exploring this area of Bucharest. Great atmosphere,  would recommend a visit.

I visited last summer and we entered this place on a morning walk (me, husband and infant baby) for a coffee. The place looks nice, we were greeted warmly but that's about it. Although there were only two clients besides us and there were plenty of employees making eye contact with us and everything, no one came to take our order. We waited for more than 30 minutes at a table right in front of the bar. Very, very rude and unprofessional.

Great selection for local and ok for international  wines. Menu has good option to taste by glass the local wines and nice food menu. Open restaurant with big terrace which is covered. To do a special tasting with the wines which are not available by glass they allow only by booking and to agree with the Manager. I was surprised and to admit was not professional to see some of the staff wearing short trousers and smoking on the terace beside the guests. Also I didn't liked it that the staff were seating when smoking.
Location is perfect in the center of Bucharest close to public transport.
Prices very reasonable around 5 Euros for a glass of local wine.

It's a quiet place to drink a glass of wine or two. Plenty of choices of Romanian or international wines from all around the world. The staff not very friendly and not too many types of beer. Only 3 types, no one local brand, no draught... for summer period it's unpleasant.

Nice selection of wines, you can open any bottle they sell for a corkage fee and enjoy it there. Food is served at a fair price for the location and service is always attentive, friendly and happy to help.

If you're looking for a cozy spot to enjoy delicious food in the heart of Bucharest, **Winestown Victoriei 37** is a fantastic choice. Located right in the city center, it's the perfect place to relax after a day of exploring. The restaurant offers a great selection of dishes, all at **reasonable prices**—an absolute bonus for anyone on a budget without compromising on quality.

The food here is definitely a highlight. The portions are generous and the flavors are spot-on. Whether you're in the mood for a hearty meal or something lighter, there's plenty to choose from. The menu offers both traditional Romanian dishes and international options, and each dish is cooked to perfection. You’ll definitely find something to satisfy your taste buds.

But what really makes **Winestown Victoriei 37** stand out is the **friendly and attentive staff**. From the moment you step in, you're greeted with a warm smile, and the service remains top-notch throughout your visit. They make sure you have everything you need without being overbearing, adding to the overall relaxed and pleasant atmosphere of the place.

The ambiance is comfortable and welcoming, making it a great spot to hang out with friends or family. Overall, we had a great time and will definitely return next time we’re in the area. If you're in Bucharest and want a good meal without breaking the bank, this place is worth checking out!

Winestone offers a sleek, contemporary wine bar atmosphere with a cozy, upscale bistro vibe. The interior feels warm and inviting, supported by smart lighting and modern décor, perfect for both business dinners and relaxed evenings.
The menu is a solid collection of well-executed bistro-style dishes: think gourmet burgers, hearty meat plates, creative salads, and global-inspired entrees using fresh Romanian ingredients. While it doesn’t break new culinary ground, food quality is consistently good and well-priced. Their wine selection is outstanding: thoughtfully curated Romanian and international labels, including boutique producers. They also host tasting events and have an attached wine shop where bottles can be purchased to enjoy at home.
Friendly, attentive service is a standout. Staff are knowledgeable about wine, with sommeliers who passionately recommend Romanian labels.

We had a great dinner. This restaurant is inside the Novotel hotel but it was unexpectedly great. I had the chicken burger which was very good. My friends had the cheese salad and the chicken salad and everything was delicious.
Yum!!!!!! Staff where great, food was so nice. Highly recommended

Nice little lobby restaurant. We didn't eat, but the food did look good. They have a great selection of Romanian wines and are very knowledgeable about them, making solid recommendations if you need help navigating local varietals.
It is a super nice location with friendly staff. I enjoyed very much the wine tasting event. :)
Very good coffee and beautiful design.  A GREAT place for work.
The building has been renovated and it has one of the prettiest interiors. The staff is nice  and their coffee makes your morning better.

The  interior is amazing and the atmosphere is so fresh. However I was a bit disappointed since the menu is not up-to-date and the only choice for breakfast was an unreasonably priced croissant. The staff was friendly though and tried to help.

Interesting location in the Bucharest city center. Old building, artistic renovation, excellent ambiance. Interesting event located there ( and this is habit of the place) - Radu Marinescu graphic exhibition - which must be seen!

We chose the perfect day to visit Cismigiu Gardens, right after a fresh, heavy snowfall. The transformation was absolute, it felt like stepping into a pristine, silent storybook. Every bench, branch, and bridge was delicately frosted, creating a breathtaking winter panorama. The park's classic, walkable paths were even more inviting under a blanket of snow, making for a wonderfully serene and picturesque stroll.

The centerpiece, of course, was the ice skating arena. Seeing skaters gracefully glide against the backdrop of the snow-dusted gardens added a vibrant, joyful energy to the tranquil scene. It’s the perfect blend of peaceful nature and gentle activity. This visit was nothing short of magical, and it’s an absolute must-see for anyone wanting to experience Bucharest's winter charm.

Parcul Cișmigiu is a large and well-maintained historic park in central Bucharest, offering a calm and relaxing atmosphere despite being close to busy areas. The park feels spacious, clean, and orderly, making it easy to walk and enjoy without feeling crowded.

Wide paths, mature trees, and landscaped areas create a pleasant setting for slow walks and short breaks. Several statues and small monuments add cultural interest along the routes, while information panels highlight local wildlife. The lake area attracts birds and changes character with the seasons; in winter, a skating rink is set up and actively used.

In addition to a modern playground for children, the park also includes a dedicated dog area further inside, with fenced sections and activity paths designed for dogs. This space is well integrated and adds to the park’s family-friendly and inclusive layout.

There are also a few areas suitable for eating or taking a break. Overall, Cișmigiu Garden is a peaceful, spacious, and well-balanced green space, ideal for families, dog owners, and anyone looking for a quiet pause in the city.

Very nice place, I went for ice skating which costs 90 lei for entering the ice skating rink (50), skates (20) and a helmet (20).
Additionally I hired a private teacher in a reasonable price and I had so much fun, I learned a lot and now I’m finally able to skate without holding to the handrail.
Maybe this is one of the oldest park in Bucharest, I’m not sure, but carries some “little Paris” vibes. If you like the colourful part of nature, I recommend to visit it between March and October.
A nice walk in the park but due to weather during early March days the lake was out of water.

A really fun restaurant with fantastic decor. It is a real novelty. The portions are gigantic! There are a few veggie options alongside the massive hunks of meat, which us nice. The service was great and Samile (sp??) was fantastic, really attentive and helpful.

I came with high expectations and was SO DISAPPOINTED.  Food was BAD, and Im not used of writing bad reviews but this has to be said.
I ordered the steak for 150 lei(!). Asked for a medium, the steak came well-done. Told the waiter, he brought me a new one, completely raw.
My friends ordered the plate for two, also ended up disappointed by the unseasoned food.
Great decor, but definitely won't come back.

Last night we went to this amazing restaurant
The set dressing was great with the swords and suits of armour
The food well I could only eat the meat on my plat so much food ( had to leave room for desert that was also gigantic)
We had a great time
Thank you to all the staff
WELL WORTH A VISIT
Its so tacky its fantastic
Be carefully its probably best to share a meal, due to the fact my partner is a veggie we had 2 separate dishes, no way could we eat more than 1/3 of the dish and im no lightweight

Well well well… the portion of the food is their strong point… the rabbit was good!!! i didnt like my papanași… not puffy, not creamy… not recommanded…the fish was steamed and not fried so not recommanded either… the schnitzel was so and so… hey by the way this is the second time that i was here… just adding the photo and video but i dont remember how good it was

To be honest the environment takes you down the medieval age.. full of life even on weekdays and the whole ambience is crazy lively with full on music. Unfortunately my whole chicken came out super dry..which did a bit but guess what upon being informed they decided not to charge us for the dry chicken which clearly shows they really care for customer experience. My boyfriend loved his food so am not gonna deduct any points although the chicken was bad. I really believe in second chances and the tables around me mentioned chicken were juicy so probably I came upon a dead one 😅
I believe the accountability and the whole experience like eating a bunch of food like in medieval times with hands other than cutlery made all the atmosphere.. was actually nice! For the food.. I believe i was a one off and they took charge.. so I got nothing than to appreciate this amazing lovely place!!

Today we visited Trattoria Mezzaluna for the first time. We wanted to see for ourselves the small restaurant with almost 4000 positive reviews.

It managed to exceed any expectation that we had. We LOVED it!!

It is the most authentic restaurant we tried in Bucharest. A combination that leads to perfection: small, intimate setting + the most dedicated and friendly staff you can imagine + exquisite Italian cuisine.

After a single visit, it became our favorite restaurant. I highly recommend it!

A truly wonderful experience at Trattoria Mezaluna. The food was excellent – fresh ingredients, perfectly cooked pasta, and beautifully balanced flavors. The wine selection paired very well with the dishes.
Special thanks to the head waiter and the entire staff for their warm, professional, and attentive service. They made the evening even more enjoyable with their kindness and attention to detail.
Highly recommended — I’ll definitely be back.

Best meal of our entire month- long trip! I can't say enough about the food and the service. I had the pork, which was crunchy on the outside and tender in the middle, and my friend had one of the pizzas, which she said was really tasty. She had the Caprese salad and I had the Halloumi salad. We loved them!
Our waiter, even with big groups, was excellent. I wish I was staying another night just to return.
The waiter was very kind and the food tasted amazing. One of the best pasta dish I’ve tried. I ordered the tagliatelle in 2 colours with shrimps, a strawberry lemonade and for desert panna cotta.

I was a bit skeptical after reading the reviews but I had a quick solo dinner here: good service with the halloumi salad, seafood pasta and a scoop of black cherry gelato. It was all delectable. Especially the salad. The pasta was a bit too Al dente for me but the gelato was lovely, a nice surprise.

I didn’t make a reservation but it was full save for the table I occupied.
The place has a very warm and welcoming atmosphere.  The staff are very friendly and attentive.  The food was delicious and coffee beautifully made

Easy the Best coffee in Bukarest!
Who wants to go to Ted if you can come here.
They have a beautiful terrace with lots of shadow, oat milk, delicious coffee and a refreshing lemonade.

I would 100% recommend to come here.
We also loved that there were so many veggie options on the menu.
Very cute place, the customer service is amazing and the food absolutely delicious 🥰

Dose has excellent specialty coffee (my favourite in București) and a variety of food options at a great price for such a high quality cafe. We have been back multiple times trying their variation of omelettes as well as treats from the cabinet like brownies. The staff have been kind, welcoming and attentive every time. We really loved the ambience created with the music as well and will be back.

Normal coffee shop
The beans was very bitter.
Prices are higher then others coffee shops
Cortado 17lei
Flat white 19lei
Too much
Good art coffee
They have brunch

name: Rio Juice
address: Intrarea Aviator Teodor Iliescu 2, 011671 București, Romania

reviews.text: Rio Juice is always a good choice if you are looking for something healthy and refreshing. 10/10, I love coming here every time.

Amazing in every weather, the açai bowls are a healthy and delicious snack! The people are very polite and friendly, the place is very clean and has a cool vibe.
The coffee is very good too!
Yummy smoothie bowls and there's also a cat passing by sometimes, which makes this the perfect place for a quick, healthy, snack. ❤️

Really wanted to try Acai Bowl for the first time in my life and it really was tasty! I’m not an expert, but I enjoy exotic and healthy dishes, and the one in the pictures (cannot remember the name, but it’s like the second one from the menu) really tastes amazing! If you want to try something different, a smoothie that you can eat just like cereal, definitely go get some! Also, the place is small and cozy, a bit hot in there, but you can stay outside on some few benches :)

One of the best acai bowls I’ve ever had. The blue spirulina bowl is very creamy and flavorful as well. The smoothies are great and they have a lot of choices to choose from. The prices are small for the quality they offer, we really recommend this place :)

Tried so many steakhouse in Romania and I started to believe they can’t get a steak right. Surprisingly this place understood what medium rare should feels like. Perfect cooking and the steer on the steak was done right. It was a chewy medium but just right. I took their highest grade kobe a5 cut and  you can taste the marbling on that piece of meat. We also took a carpaccio and a salad as appetizer. All great choice.  Very costly but you get the best.

Food was incredible, the meat selection of course being the main attraction. Other food items and wine we tried paired really well as well, living up to the same standard. Staff is very polite and attentive and offered great service throughout the whole dinner. Atmosphere good as well.

A bit pricier but the food was great! The steak was cooked by the book and delicious. I recommend parmesan and garlic fries, they are very good. Service was excelent and quick. Andreea was very nice!:) I recommend this place!:)

Visiting from the UK and was very happy with our visit!
Food was incredible m, steak cooked to perfection and staff very friendly and professional, they cannot do enough for you!

The food is amazing, and the same goes for the service. They are patient and make sure to help you in the best way they can. Recommend it to real steak enjoyers!

I can call this place my favorite steak restaurant in Bucharest!

Prices are good. 55 ron for a burger with fries.
Fries are good, but they are the frozen kind. not freshly prepared.
We tried Circus beer, totally recommend.
Perfect place to grab a bite and hang out with your friends or significant other. The atmosphere is chill and the music is nice.

Insanely good and original burgers, with local vibes in the recipe. The atmosphere is cool and happy. Definitely kids friendly although the adults need this place more than them! Cause we deserve happiness in our meals. And these guys deliver this! At each bite.

Definitely the best burgers in Bucharest. You may find here all the classics, but also very tasty and innovative burgers, champions almost every year at Burger Fest. The staff is very friendly. The restaurant is pretty small so it’s best to make a reservation

The big one is for a real gymrat, it s too big and is for the real meat lovers, very high protein and perfect after a destroying workout, I warn you that you won't feel much of the rest of the ingredients.

We haven’t been in this restaurant for a while now. The interior deco is newly uodated , nice modern touch, good music . Waiters were very profesional and friendly. Food delicious.. as always . Well done !

Zen Sushi is the best choice if you are craving some fresh delicious sushi in Bucharest. I love trying all of their locations, each and every time I end up being pleasantly surprised by both the staff and the food. I totally recommend their sashimi platter for two - it is amazing!

Best sushi in Bucharest, consistently overtime, excellent quality, always super fresh sushi, tasty soups and Japanese warm meals, amazing plating, very professional and friendly staff. Great value for money.
Absolutely brilliant. The staff is friendly and really cares about yoyr needs. As for the food, is simply Ineffable. I  recommend it 100%!😝

I am extremely pleased with my experience at ZenSushi Dorobanți. The food quality is absolutely outstanding – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was impeccable, with attention to detail and a warm, welcoming attitude that made the evening even more enjoyable. The restaurant itself is spotless, which really adds to the overall comfort and atmosphere.

A special mention goes to Marian, our server, who was professional, friendly, and attentive throughout the entire visit. He made sure everything was perfect and went above and beyond to create a wonderful dining experience.

Highly recommend ZenSushi Dorobanți – one of the best sushi experiences in Bucharest!

The best and freshest seafood I had on a 5 week trip in Europe ( May 2025). The Langoustine grilled simply with extra virgin olive oil was divine. The seafood stew/bisque was flavorful…almost tasted better than a Cioppino from Tattich without the saffron. Visited twice and definitely a must go when next in Bucharest, Romania.

Top restaurant in Bucharest. The food is amazing, never ate something so good in Romania. The fish, the fried rice and the desserts are amazing.
Must try!

Perfect atmosphere and food
Edy took great care of us
Definitely coming back

Ordered a light lunch for tasting
Seafood borscht was beautiful, full of umami goodness & finesse
Grilled broccolini with hazelnut sauce was an interesting twist
Grilled calamari was nice, could have done a bit more time on the fire
Overall it was nice but i expected more with this price point
Great food and excellent service. Not just fish (our all time fav - “bors”) but also the aubergines and sweet potatoes were delicious.

name: YUKI japanese home dining
address: Strada Puțul lui Zamfir 5, 011681 București, Romania

reviews.text: Even from the entrance,  I've felt like I was back in Japan. The food was extremely close to the authentic one. Best Kaarage out of Japan, so far (please add also the Japanese mayonnaise). Hot sake 🔥 Next time we will try ramen, for sure. Itadakimasu 🙏

PROS: Always a pleasure to dine here. Went for a Valentine’s date and had a wonderful experience. I had the salmon schnitzel, perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

CONS: There was a side of sad Mega Image salad with the salmon that I found unnecessary and funny and the romanian waitress could work on her hospitality skills a little — a bit cold and curt compared to her colleagues who were very warm :)

All in all though, a great restaurant with authentic Japanese food & Asahi beer.

Me and my husband celebrated my birthday here, and it was a simply wonderful experience! From the moment we arrived, the host was incredibly polite. The wait time for our food was fast, and everything we ordered was delicious. I recommend the Curry Udon and Asahi beer 😋You won't be disappointed!

Make sure you get a reservation if you want to have dinner since the place is very popular. I had to return the next day and have lunch and it was absolutely worth it. The atmosphere is outstanding and so is the food. The set menu is a great idea! The staff took the time to explain everything and I left with a smile on my face!
tito give an amazing service and the food is wonderful. the best matcha ice cream i had so far. everything was great

The atmosphere is the most pleasant element in this dining experience. Especially in the summer the little garden is quite beautiful and tucked away from the busy main street. The food itself looks good and sounds good, but from a taste perspective it could have been better. I don't mean it tastes bad, just that when you read the description you would expect it to taste better. I do however recommend the smoked/marinated fish appetizers. Those were fantastic!

EXQUISITE EXPERIENCE.
We were utterly stunned to have found a restaurant in such a level in Bucharest.
Lovely food and OUTSTANDING service by the gentleman who was waiting the tables.

Surprisingly we were the only diners in the restaurant that evening (not sure how that happened)
So I must recommend this place warmly.
❤️🫶🏼

Expensive restaurant. Well decorated Some how empty.
We had duck in cranberry and veggie shepherd's pie. The duck was plain, just cut the meat and put cranberry souce on it.
The pie was better with rich flavors.

I feel sorry to don’t see this restaurant FULL ! It’s a good gastronomic restaurant, even if on my fillet beef missed some salt but all the diner was super good : tartar beef, marined sea bass, lamb, beef fillet !

I cannot understand comment of other customer upset … of course price is not cheap, it’s normal it’s gastronomic !
Bravo to the chef even the server was kind ( very rare in romania ) haha

5 stars for the place, the serving, the design of the space, the peaceful atmosphere and the cleanliness. We had a nice drink outside, on the terrace and up to a certain point, we were the only ones there. However, the food is too fancy and there isn't such a great variety for my taste. It's a fine dining restaurant, I understand that, but I've seen better menus for such locations. Worth a try for a date (single or in pairs with other couple friends) or a pretentious dinner.
Delicious! It has that homey vibe and home-made taste! Very friendly service :)

Just had lunch there. AMAZING lovely service, so nice to have a happy, solicitous and promt waitress! the food was very good, clean and homey. I LOVED the chicken soup, it reminded me of my mom :) and the Lava cake was TO DIE for AND served with ice cream... also, on top of everything else, I had a chicken soup with bread, a main course of grilled chicken with wedges, a huge latte coffee, a water bottle and a lava cake with ice cream for like 42 lei TOTAL ... AND the bathroom was clean and the place it's SMOKE FREE on the inside... top place in floreasca for sure! :D it was also luck that we had the place for ourselves :p
One of the best experiences in the central part of the city. Smashed burger was amazing!
Best food in town and great prices!!! I recommend every burger from the menu!!🏆
best italian kitchen in town! staff very friendly and careful

Sunny day, good vibe, bad service…
I asked for a soup and a burger to be served in the same time, and the soupwas brought after 10-15 minutes. Then the bottle of water. Then the glasses for the water. And finally the burger with the fries. At least the food was decent
Been here today in a group of 4. Service provided by Nabin Fixx was perfect. Always polite and attentive. The food was amazing, the cocktails well mixed and beer fresh from the tap.

Best service ever!!!! Thank you Nabin Fixx!!!! We loved our lunch and your service. Absolutely spot on. And lovely to hear you speak Romanian so well. Congratulations! We will definitely come back again soon thanks to you. More staff should be like you ❤️

We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, and everything was fresh and perfectly cooked. The service was very friendly and fast, which made our visit even more enjoyable.
Our waitress, Rodica, was extremely kind and sweet. She made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived and took great care of us throughout the meal.
We highly recommend the beef schnitzel – it was outstanding and definitely a must-try!
We will gladly come back again.
Food was delicious and the service provided by Lorena was excellent. She was very attentive and helped us with the perfect recommendations.

Given that this is part of a big chain of restaurants of all sorts including City Grill, Caru' cu Bere and Hanul Berarilor, I came expecting mediocrity. However I was actually pleasantly surprised at least by the Carbonara which is my usual litmus test for Italian food. They used the correct ingredients and mostly the correct preparation though the spaghetti was a little overcooked by Italian standards but perfect for my father who actually ordered the dish. My pizza was nothing to complain about and neither were the penne quatro frommagi but both felt like there was a little something missing. Still overall I would say you could certainly do worse, even in horrible tourist areas of Italy so it may be worth giving a shot.

Great Italian spot with a warm, elegant atmosphere. We had the pizza, eggplant salad with Parmesan, and focaccia , everything was fresh, flavorful, and very well made. High-quality ingredients, authentic Italian taste, and professional, welcoming service. A lovely place for a relaxed and satisfying meal.

We had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely excellent, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was just as impressive, the staff were attentive, kind, and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed.

We came with two small kids, and the team did everything possible to make us feel comfortable. They were patient, accommodating, and made the whole experience stress-free and enjoyable for the whole family.
Highly recommended.  We’ll definitely be coming back!
I ordered the carbonara and it was amazing! The waiter Ajay was really helpful and kind. I would definitely recommend to come here if you’re in Bucharest!⭐️

Wow what a delicious sea food dishes here….
Ajay did a great and professional job a big thanks to Ajay…. Highly recommended

A very charming restaurant in Bucharest where you truly feel like you’re in Spain. The interior is beautiful, spacious, and decorated in a traditional Andalusian style, which creates a warm and authentic atmosphere. Although the space is large, the tables can be a bit close together, so you might occasionally hear other conversations, which can be slightly distracting.

The food is excellent — everything I’ve ordered so far has been delicious. I was pleasantly surprised to find Padrón peppers here that taste just as good as the ones in Spain. I often order the baked shrimp and highly recommend them. The sangria is also very good, which is surprisingly hard to find done well. One small downside is that sometimes there’s a noticeable food smell inside the restaurant.

Overall, it’s my favorite Spanish restaurant in the city so far, and I will definitely be coming back.

This is my favourite restaurant in Bucharest for the spanish dishes, especially paella, and because they maintained the quality of food over the years. The food was delicious, with quality ingredients. The desserts were a little too sweet for my taste.
But I was very disappointed about the service last time I visited. The lady who took our order seemed to be on the run every time we interacted,  did not offer any recommendation and I felt like I was disturbing her with my questions or additions to the initial order: like ordering another bottle of water or a coffee.
The most unpleasant surprise came with the bill. Without asking me, they have included  in the bill a 10% tip and brought us the bill at the table with the tip included. Not even when she brought the bill, she did not mention anything about 10% tip as being already included. And I paid the bill by card for the total amount, not noticing the tip added abusively.
And I offered also a 10% tip in cash, because that’s the minimum tip I usually offer if I enjoy the food and services. And I liked the food, despite the rush in attitude of the waitress.
Of course I paid the 10% tip calculated to the total amount already paid by card…
It is not mainly a matter of amount, it is a mater of fact. I felt that they robbed me intentionally, counting on my lack of attention. And I considered this a complete lack of respect for the client.
But, I would give second chances to this restaurant, as the food is great and I do hope that they will improve their service and consideration for their clients.
Me on my side, I will check carefully the bill and sanction any future discrepancy 10 times harder, in reviews. Which I do recommend to any client reading this.

The food is really, really good, and that’s coming from someone who grew up in Spain, it’s 1-1 with what you get there. The paella was delicious, just like every time I’ve been here. The staff is super professional and friendly, and the place totally teleports you to southern Spain for a few hours. I wholeheartedly recommend it! (and let’s not forget the tapas and the complimentary bizcocho de limon we got from the house)

Delicious Spanish food. The atmosphere is nice, cozy, with natural flowers and plants, semi dark warm light , excellent for a relaxed atmosphere. The service was excellent! Christian was very kind, professional and friendly. I definitely recommend this place. I return to this place again and again.

“Authentic Spanish flavors in the heart of Bucharest!”
I visited Casa España by Alioli and was genuinely impressed — the food was excellent, beautifully presented, and full of authentic Spanish taste. The atmosphere is warm and elegant, and the staff were attentive without being intrusive. Highly recommend the paella and sangria!

The food was great, no surprise Sushizen is one of the best Asian restaurants in Bucharest ✨
One of the best tempuras in the city (forgot to take a photo with all 3 pieces), the Zen menu was fulfilling and the sashimi was generous as well!
The chocolate mousse deserves a special nod, it was beyond delicious 😍
Who has never tried it, book a table now 📆
We will definitely come back!

Best sushi place in Bucharest, proper, fresh. Nice plating, consistent over time
Bit pricey…. And crammed table set-up
Great service! This location is a bit crowded, so it's not such a good idea for a date, but for a normal lunch, it's perfect!

The place looked great, it was a mix between traditional Japanese restaurant and new, reinvented 5 star restaurant.
We ordered ramen (without meat) it was decent, I'd give it an 8 out of 10. Not enough flavour, it might be a personal prefference, but it was quite bland.

Sushi was better, but the rolls were unevenly cut, some pieces being too big and needed 2 bites. Furthermore, the rice was a bit sticky, the rolls unfolding when trying to pick it up from the plate.

The drinks were decent, we had. Hugo and a Mojito.

Overall? I'd say a 7/10, not the best, but not the worst either. P.s. the pictures may look appealing, yet the taste is the one that matters 😉
We had the supreme sushi set which was really tasty. Desserts were ok.

Poesia – One of the Most Unique Restaurants in Bucharest

I had the pleasure of dining at Poesia in Bucharest on December 1st, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. Situated on the elegant Aviatorilor Avenue, this restaurant is set inside a beautifully restored old house, giving it a warm, charming, and sophisticated atmosphere. The interior is absolutely stunning – classic architecture meets tasteful modern touches, making it one of the most visually impressive dining spots in Bucharest.

The food at Poesia is equally exceptional. Every dish is thoughtfully prepared, fresh, and bursting with flavor. From the carefully crafted starters to the perfectly executed main courses, everything was a delight both in taste and presentation. The service was excellent – professional, attentive, and friendly, creating a seamless and enjoyable dining experience.

Overall, Poesia offers more than just a meal; it’s a full experience combining exquisite cuisine, elegant ambiance, and top-notch service. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for a refined night out in Bucharest, Poesia stands out as one of the city’s most unique and memorable restaurants. I highly recommend it and can’t wait for my next visit!

Simply amazing from the service, food and atmosphere, all in a cozy designed reataurant.
Food was simply amazing, in top 2 meals so far this year.
We’ll 100% visit again.

Lovely location. Great food. The service can br deffinitelly improved. Our waiter didn't want to take the order for the starters because we have not decided yet the main course. And this was really unpolite.

Really good seafood, especially the shrimp carpaccio. The beef fillet was nice, but not as impressive as the seafood or pasta. The restaurant is nice as well, it’s much better on the terrace in nice weather. I’ve been here a few times, and I’ve noticed that the inside staff tends to be a bit less attentive and a bit more negligent. I’m really nitpicking here, as I want this place to keep up the good work.

We went there on a Saturday evening. It's easy to get there from the Aviatorilor subway. We went around 7PM, with reservation. At 8PM it gets crowded.
The place is very nice, warm, inviting.
They don't have any cocktails or beer, being an italian restaurant. They only have water and different types of wine.

The music was ok and the volume was set ideally, not to hear clearly the conversations around, but still allowing us to talk normally and understand each other.

I appreciated that they brought us a starter on the house: two types of butter (very good the one with the truffles), olives and 4 types of bread (the round one and the slices of the white bread were very much enjoyed).

The food was good, personally I think that the green pepper sauce for the meat could have been more fresh (speaking of taste) and hot (also speaking of taste) and the green leaf used to decorate the meat dish overpowered the sauce, at least.
The fries were perfect.

It was a pleasant experience. We enjoyed ourselves. Cheers!

I recently visited Pata Negra and it truly felt like a little slice of Spain. The atmosphere was warm and vibrant, with Spanish music playing and a cozy, lively vibe. I went with a big group and we ordered family style and tried a big variety of dishes: several tapas, a seafood and a duck paellas - everything was fresh and full of flavor. The ingredients seemed genuinely Spanish, and you could tell the owners care about authenticity.

Service was friendly overall, though I did notice some guests waiting a bit longer for their food. If you go on a busy evening, I’d recommend making a reservation and maybe sitting inside, since the outdoor area can get hot in summer.

Prices are mid to high, but for the quality and ambiance, I think it’s worth it. All in all, a great spot if you’re craving authentic Spanish food and a festive night out.

We made a reservation on the terrace, for two, on a Saturday evening. The place is perfect for a relaxing hot summer evening.
The gin cocktails recommended by the waiter were good.
The food was ok. I enjoyed the red sauce with the mashed potatoes from my plate and my boyfriend liked the shrimps.
The online menu needs to be updated and the English descriptions of the food items should be in sync with the Romanian ones.
The waiter's recommendation on food and drinks was a match for us, so thank you for that!

Amazing food! The paella and the octopus are simply the best in Bucharest, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The location is absolutely beautiful, creating a wonderful atmosphere for a perfect dining experience. Highly recommended!

One the best restaurants in the city and with the most authentic Spanish cuisine.
I adore Spanish cuisine and here I have experienced a bit of Spain ❤️
The atmosphere is nice, cozy, they have a great attention to detail - the service is impeccable.
The prices are on the higher side, but it’s worth once in a while.

This place is fantastic! The owner is also the chef so you can feel the passion and care in the food. Every time we came here it was amazing! They offered us complimentary home made digestives too. Highly recommended!

Flawless, the service at Fish House is flawless – attentive without being intrusive, genuinely friendly, and highly professional. Food was impeccable, fresh and tasty. Florin taken care of our table making our dinner an amazing experience.

Fish House in Bucharest offers a delightful seafood dining experience, with some standout moments and room for small improvements.

The food overall was very good, with the potato chips being an absolute highlight—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and truly memorable. While most dishes shone, the fried calamari left room for improvement; perhaps a lighter batter or a touch more seasoning could elevate it to match the quality of the rest of the menu.

What truly set the experience apart was the service. Our waiter was an absolute gem—attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. Their professionalism and warm demeanor added a special touch to the evening.

Fish House is a solid choice for seafood lovers in Bucharest, combining good food with exceptional service. With a little refinement on the calamari, it could easily become a five-star destination.

Some of the best food I ever had! Every item was delicious and beautifully presented.
Extraordinary service and polite staff. Elegant atmosphere.

I highlight the roasted peppers, sea bream carpatio, tuna sashimi, and honey cake. These were outstanding and my favorites!

Romantic, fresh and great service.

Returned in Dec 2025- I had the sea bass carpaccio, the langostino pasta with black truffles, and lovely olive and black truffle cream to start. Just delicious and amazing service.

These restaurant is exceptional started from the service, atmosphere and the food
The waiter made his job very professionally and customer orientated
The sea bass truffle carpaccio was to die for
Black caviar and mini blinis excellent
Various wine selection

name: rawdia
address: Strada Puțul lui Zamfir 50 - 52, 011682 București, Romania

reviews.text: Pricey, but the food is great! We liked the location and might come back!

Cool, hidden culinary gem on a connecting street between bulevards. We went for breakfast, first time there after hearing by chance about this place. Finding a fun, cozy and enjoyable atmosphere. Lots of laughter from the team, while busy preparing the numerous orders to deliver.
Our avocado cashew toast and ginger lemonade were delicious, the sweets looked very inviting but didn’t have any this time. The place has just a few tables inside and a couple on the sidewalk in front. You can fully see the kitchen where the goodies are prepared and everything looked spotless. They have an offer for a daily menu with soup and main dish. We saw the crew putting packs together for the delivery, also here laughter and friendly words shared. For anyone enjoying vegetarian, raw vegan and gluten free cuisine, the place is absolutely a must-go.

Lovely bistro with good choice of vegan/vegetarian food. We tried an awesome version of vegan sushi and very good penne with sauce similar to ragu but made with sunflower seeds. The service was great and the food came very fast. Free tap water served without us even asking was a nice touch.

Delicious vegan food served in a charming restaurant with a versatile terrace suitable for both winter and summer, equipped with skins reminiscent of Nordic countries and blankets, creating a cozy atmosphere. I opted for the burger and chocolate cake, all for less than 100 lei, and they even provide a pitcher of water. I'll definitely be back.

Total price 13,46 euros /66 lei

Unpretentious and clean with warm and friendly service. I had the tzatziki with avocado and protein burger with champignon mushrooms and they were delectable. I ended my meal with a cappuccino and the raw chocolate tart with raspberry which was perfection. A bit too much for one sitting so I had 1/2 the dessert to go and q green juice.

Organised a small family and friends gathering with Ema’s help. She is the heart and soul of the place. Every guest was impressed by the food and the atmosphere, and felt like home. Ema helped us with the flower and table arrangements, the seating plan, or even small details like a phone charger or an advil for some
of our guests. Definitely my go-to option or strong recommendation for medium gatherings, as the restaurant’s capacity is of ca. 28 attendees. Maybe a cocktail format could allow more guests. The first 2 photos and the video are not from the day of the event.
Cute family owned spot in the middle of the city. Quiet and intimate, with a cozy atmosphere. I keep returning , definitely recommend for coffee/brunch/cocktails

The most amazing place, in beautiful French inspired town.  The staff was incredible.  The place is warm and welcoming, the food was fantastic and the coffee was just as great! The pouched eggs are probably the best I’ve ever had! The bacon nice and crispy and the avocado extremely fresh!

I highly recommend a visit, you won’t be disappointed!

It was so good we kept going back!
To the team there thank you so much!

Cute place with friendly people. I felt very posh when they brought my coffee in a glass cup. The waiter was very courteous.
I ordered an asparagus salad and what i got was two mediocrely cooked sunny side up eggs sitting on a few asparagus stalks and some zucchini. I wouldn’t call that a salad, and I wouldn’t have ordered it if I knew what it was.
Everything else was nice.  Not the place to go with your laptop to do work, because they don’t have internet for guests.

A quint place for brunch. Quite a varied menu with breakfast items. You can also go there for lunch or dinner, but the menu is not as attractive. There's no particular theme on the cuisine (pasta, fish, quesadilla, schnitzel etc). The food is ok, nothing special to mention about it. The atmosphere/design of the terrace is French, but can be tidier. The service was quick, and the staff is helpful. The beverage prices are very high, while the food ones are average for the area.
