Great place ! Perfect for group  events  and also for nice gatherings. Very intimate and with a warm atmosphere. Food also great . Great value for money overall
Thank you for wonderful experiences! We are always happy to return here!
Pleasant and cozy location for short meetings and quick bites. Great coffee and very polite owner.
Nice enviroment, very good food, friendly people around you! Awesome!
Nice place. Personel very service minded.

Few but tasty vegan/vegetarian options. Staff friendly, food is slow cooked, seating outside, tables could use some bussing skills, but all in all a good experience.

Ask for halloumi cheese, this Greek sortment they cook on the grill. Became vegan in the meanwhile, but the taste still lingers somewhere between the insular lobe and the inferior frontal gyrus of the frontal lobe. Yum!

You won’t have a better experience anywhere else! The hospitality was unexpected and unmatched. If you get the chance, talk to Vic, the owner. He has the best stories, and treats his customers like old friends. The food and drinks were also amazing. So glad we stopped by.
superb comfort food, rapane nr 1

All dishes are showing the passion for tasty food and the professional craftsmanship for doin’at.
Moreover, it is Vic, the soul and core of the business, who’s a great guy, that kind of the finest and dedicated man for his business.
Good luck in everything you re doin Vic and keep up giving us the best food in town!
Rem

I mean, i had better fries in my nightmares but even with that, food was spot one. Tasty, a bit spicy(chicken tikka and Cubano) and decent portion for the price, but more than anything really tasty, especially the Cubano.

Today we visited Trattoria Mezzaluna for the first time. We wanted to see for ourselves the small restaurant with almost 4000 positive reviews.

It managed to exceed any expectation that we had. We LOVED it!!

It is the most authentic restaurant we tried in Bucharest. A combination that leads to perfection: small, intimate setting + the most dedicated and friendly staff you can imagine + exquisite Italian cuisine.

After a single visit, it became our favorite restaurant. I highly recommend it!

A truly wonderful experience at Trattoria Mezaluna. The food was excellent – fresh ingredients, perfectly cooked pasta, and beautifully balanced flavors. The wine selection paired very well with the dishes.
Special thanks to the head waiter and the entire staff for their warm, professional, and attentive service. They made the evening even more enjoyable with their kindness and attention to detail.
Highly recommended — I’ll definitely be back.

Best meal of our entire month- long trip! I can't say enough about the food and the service. I had the pork, which was crunchy on the outside and tender in the middle, and my friend had one of the pizzas, which she said was really tasty. She had the Caprese salad and I had the Halloumi salad. We loved them!
Our waiter, even with big groups, was excellent. I wish I was staying another night just to return.
The waiter was very kind and the food tasted amazing. One of the best pasta dish I’ve tried. I ordered the tagliatelle in 2 colours with shrimps, a strawberry lemonade and for desert panna cotta.

I was a bit skeptical after reading the reviews but I had a quick solo dinner here: good service with the halloumi salad, seafood pasta and a scoop of black cherry gelato. It was all delectable. Especially the salad. The pasta was a bit too Al dente for me but the gelato was lovely, a nice surprise.

I didn’t make a reservation but it was full save for the table I occupied.
The place has a very warm and welcoming atmosphere.  The staff are very friendly and attentive.  The food was delicious and coffee beautifully made

Easy the Best coffee in Bukarest!
Who wants to go to Ted if you can come here.
They have a beautiful terrace with lots of shadow, oat milk, delicious coffee and a refreshing lemonade.

I would 100% recommend to come here.
We also loved that there were so many veggie options on the menu.
Very cute place, the customer service is amazing and the food absolutely delicious 🥰

Dose has excellent specialty coffee (my favourite in București) and a variety of food options at a great price for such a high quality cafe. We have been back multiple times trying their variation of omelettes as well as treats from the cabinet like brownies. The staff have been kind, welcoming and attentive every time. We really loved the ambience created with the music as well and will be back.

Normal coffee shop
The beans was very bitter.
Prices are higher then others coffee shops
Cortado 17lei
Flat white 19lei
Too much
Good art coffee
They have brunch

name: Rio Juice
address: Intrarea Aviator Teodor Iliescu 2, 011671 București, Romania

reviews.text: Rio Juice is always a good choice if you are looking for something healthy and refreshing. 10/10, I love coming here every time.

Amazing in every weather, the açai bowls are a healthy and delicious snack! The people are very polite and friendly, the place is very clean and has a cool vibe.
The coffee is very good too!
Yummy smoothie bowls and there's also a cat passing by sometimes, which makes this the perfect place for a quick, healthy, snack. ❤️

Really wanted to try Acai Bowl for the first time in my life and it really was tasty! I’m not an expert, but I enjoy exotic and healthy dishes, and the one in the pictures (cannot remember the name, but it’s like the second one from the menu) really tastes amazing! If you want to try something different, a smoothie that you can eat just like cereal, definitely go get some! Also, the place is small and cozy, a bit hot in there, but you can stay outside on some few benches :)

One of the best acai bowls I’ve ever had. The blue spirulina bowl is very creamy and flavorful as well. The smoothies are great and they have a lot of choices to choose from. The prices are small for the quality they offer, we really recommend this place :)

name: YUKI japanese home dining
address: Strada Puțul lui Zamfir 5, 011681 București, Romania

reviews.text: Even from the entrance,  I've felt like I was back in Japan. The food was extremely close to the authentic one. Best Kaarage out of Japan, so far (please add also the Japanese mayonnaise). Hot sake 🔥 Next time we will try ramen, for sure. Itadakimasu 🙏

PROS: Always a pleasure to dine here. Went for a Valentine’s date and had a wonderful experience. I had the salmon schnitzel, perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

CONS: There was a side of sad Mega Image salad with the salmon that I found unnecessary and funny and the romanian waitress could work on her hospitality skills a little — a bit cold and curt compared to her colleagues who were very warm :)

All in all though, a great restaurant with authentic Japanese food & Asahi beer.

Me and my husband celebrated my birthday here, and it was a simply wonderful experience! From the moment we arrived, the host was incredibly polite. The wait time for our food was fast, and everything we ordered was delicious. I recommend the Curry Udon and Asahi beer 😋You won't be disappointed!

Make sure you get a reservation if you want to have dinner since the place is very popular. I had to return the next day and have lunch and it was absolutely worth it. The atmosphere is outstanding and so is the food. The set menu is a great idea! The staff took the time to explain everything and I left with a smile on my face!
tito give an amazing service and the food is wonderful. the best matcha ice cream i had so far. everything was great

We really enjoyed our meal at Old Kitchen. The food was excellent and high quality, and the place was clean and pleasant.
It was recommended to us as traditional Romanian cuisine, but in our opinion, it felt more like traditional Hungarian cuisine. Either way, it was classic, honest food that we truly enjoyed.
Definitely worth a visit.

I am so sad that I could not be able to try all their dishes all at once. The food was so tasty with home flavours and quality that you could feel and fresh products. The staff was very kind and the atmosphere very very warm. What I noticed and really got my attention is how incredibly clean and ordered was the kitchen. Congratulation for this beautiful gem and that you cook with heart and simplicity! Can't wait to come back some day💞

Warm welcome, well decorated restaurant. Plenty of traditional dishes available and for all taste. We spent a great time just before closure of the restaurant. Staff was available for explanations, patient and polite. The food was excellent, well recommended.

We were looking for some traditional Romanian food and the place did not disappoint. You can taste various Transylvanian dishes. Everything was freshly prepared, hot, the waiting time was short. The owners were kind in their own way 😅- at least nothing was faked which for me is a plus. You could see locals eating there. I recommend booking a table because the place is rather small, yet very cozy!
Delicious, authentic Romanian food. The Eggplant Salad and the Chicken in Sour Cherry Sauce were divine! Would highly recommend both (and no meal would be complete without their homemade lemonade)!

Visited Bucharest and it was quite hard to find vegan food to be honest. This place is a gem!
I had the mushroom soup, the shiitake mushroom curry with rice and the tiramisu!
All of them were extremely tasty, best food I had in Romania by far!! The owners are lovely and friendly.
I forgot my beanie there - initially I thought I had lost it - and they kept it safe for me, which turned my day around. As a thank you I bought more food for dinner!

Definitely a place you should visit even if you are not vegan as the food as spot on!  😊

Best vegan food in Bucharest! Romania has been a struggle but so may great options here and the staff were very friendly and explained all the menu clearly with great English. I had the broccoli soup and a beyond burger bowl

Small raw vegan bistro with generous selection of dishes. They probably have the largest vegan menu in Bucharest. Been there several times and confirm they're great in cooking mushrooms. Pleurotus soup is one of the main attraction. Fast and efficient service. Music is a bit boring, but they do a lot of deliveries.

Finding vegetarian options in Romania can be hard, however, this bistro is a great choice. We ordered a rice spaghetti with shiitake mushroom, creamy pumpkin soup and beyond meat with grilled vegetables. The dishes are delicious and not excessively seasoned. And they are also healthy. The staff is friendly and smiley. It is a good choice for vegetarian traveller.

This is our favourite restaurant we ate at during our time in Romania. The staff were so lovely and accommodating, explaining each of the dishes in depth. The atmosphere was very calm and relaxing and the food was delicious! We would definitely recommend if you are visiting Bucharest ❤️

The atmosphere is the most pleasant element in this dining experience. Especially in the summer the little garden is quite beautiful and tucked away from the busy main street. The food itself looks good and sounds good, but from a taste perspective it could have been better. I don't mean it tastes bad, just that when you read the description you would expect it to taste better. I do however recommend the smoked/marinated fish appetizers. Those were fantastic!

EXQUISITE EXPERIENCE.
We were utterly stunned to have found a restaurant in such a level in Bucharest.
Lovely food and OUTSTANDING service by the gentleman who was waiting the tables.

Surprisingly we were the only diners in the restaurant that evening (not sure how that happened)
So I must recommend this place warmly.
❤️🫶🏼

Expensive restaurant. Well decorated Some how empty.
We had duck in cranberry and veggie shepherd's pie. The duck was plain, just cut the meat and put cranberry souce on it.
The pie was better with rich flavors.

I feel sorry to don’t see this restaurant FULL ! It’s a good gastronomic restaurant, even if on my fillet beef missed some salt but all the diner was super good : tartar beef, marined sea bass, lamb, beef fillet !

I cannot understand comment of other customer upset … of course price is not cheap, it’s normal it’s gastronomic !
Bravo to the chef even the server was kind ( very rare in romania ) haha

5 stars for the place, the serving, the design of the space, the peaceful atmosphere and the cleanliness. We had a nice drink outside, on the terrace and up to a certain point, we were the only ones there. However, the food is too fancy and there isn't such a great variety for my taste. It's a fine dining restaurant, I understand that, but I've seen better menus for such locations. Worth a try for a date (single or in pairs with other couple friends) or a pretentious dinner.

name: Galli, rôtisserie Française
address: Strada General Christian Tell 6-8, 010384 București, Romania

reviews.text: Been going to this place for a while and they always have the best sandwiches with fresh and delicious ingredients. For 16 lei, the price of an unhealthy and boring kebab, you can have any sandwich they have on the list. The staff is great and always helpful! Of course, you can eat roasted chicken or pork etc. Definitely check this out if you want to have a great lunch!

Delicious sandwiches and a very fancy spot in the heart of the city. They offer good quality chicken meat. I am a vegetarian and enjoyed the 2 types of vegetarian sandwiches. The staff is very kind and they speak French, English and obviously Romanian. Cross the road and enjoy the architectural beauty of the Amzei church.
Tasty sandwiches with fresh ingredients. You can feel that the chicken is the real deal
Excellent food, lots of spices :)

How could one not love this place? I've been here lots of times and I've always been pleasantly surprised. The people here are some of the nicest people, food tastes absolutely fantastic  (especially the chicken salad and potatoes) and the design is really nice.

★★★★★
We are currently staying at Edison Blue in Bucharest, and we’re genuinely impressed by the level of care and professionalism throughout the hotel.

First of all, a big thank you to the hotel management and the entire team, especially the staff at the reception and information desk — they respond quickly, handle any request with ease, and always do it in a friendly, respectful way. The hotel is clean, well organized, and the spa is absolutely amazing — a perfect place to truly relax.

And a special thank you to the Business Lounge, especially Claudia. Today she made our visit feel truly special — warm attention, great service, and beautifully prepared pancakes served with real care and detail. That kind of hospitality stays with you.

Thank you again to everyone at Edison Blue for creating such a welcoming experience. Highly recommended.

I am currently staying in Bucharest at the Raddison Blu, and the experience has been fantastic. I was meant to be staying on a local Airbnb but had to leave due to cleanliness. I went to the Raddison and the team were brilliant. Aysha is a credit to the organisation. She was polite, friendly and pressional. She is the exact person you want to encounter when staying on a hotel. Her customer service skills are to be commended.

One of the best stays I’ve ever had at Radisson. As a VIP guest, I was upgraded to a renovated two-level room, which made the experience even more special.

The breakfasts were excellent, with a great variety and quality. The hotel features an outdoor pool shared between Radisson Blu and Park Inn, which is a lovely bonus. There’s also a fitness center and an indoor pool connected to the hotels, both complimentary for guests.

Additionally, the minibar is included once per stay, which is a nice extra touch.

Me and my girlfriend stayed in Radisson Blu Bucharest from the 23rd to the 26th of January. It was such an amazing experience from all points of view. All the staff members went anice and beyond to make our stay seamless. At the check-in we were welcomed by Valentina that has quickly registeres us and provided all the information, she was great and helped us during our stay for everything we needed. I would also like to mention the night manager Eric and the receptionist Alina who helped us to confirm a late check out during our last day (we had a late flight). Thanks a lot.

The executive lounge in the hotel is really amazing and there are exceptional people working there. In particular one staff member stands out, Marius, a very professional employee that was very kind with us and also spoke italian, he made us feel like at home.

If you are a fit person there is a gym fully equipped with a internal pool and you can also relax inside an amazing esternal heated pool with jacuzzi.

The cherry on top was the Thai SPA, were we had a couple massage on the last day. The SPA is really great, equipped with everything you may need, very clean and there are very professional therapists there. I strongly suggest reserving a massage during your visit.

Finally, everything about the hotel is 5 out of 5 stars: nice rooms, professional staff, great guest experience, great location. I strongly reccomend staying here if you will visit Bucharest!

We had a wonderful stay at Radisson Blu Hotel Bucharest, and we truly can’t recommend it enough.

From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding — professional, warm, and attentive to every detail. The rooms were spotless, beautifully maintained, and extremely comfortable, which made our stay even more enjoyable and relaxing.

A special and heartfelt thank you goes to Madalina Agiu, Lobby Duty Manager, who went above and beyond to make our experience exceptional. Madalina assisted us with everything we needed, always with patience, kindness, and a genuine desire to help. Her service was not only efficient but also incredibly caring and personal, and it truly made a difference in our stay.

It’s rare to encounter such a high level of hospitality, and thanks to the excellent team — especially Madalina — our stay was memorable in the best possible way.

Highly recommended, and we would happily return again!

A very charming restaurant in Bucharest where you truly feel like you’re in Spain. The interior is beautiful, spacious, and decorated in a traditional Andalusian style, which creates a warm and authentic atmosphere. Although the space is large, the tables can be a bit close together, so you might occasionally hear other conversations, which can be slightly distracting.

The food is excellent — everything I’ve ordered so far has been delicious. I was pleasantly surprised to find Padrón peppers here that taste just as good as the ones in Spain. I often order the baked shrimp and highly recommend them. The sangria is also very good, which is surprisingly hard to find done well. One small downside is that sometimes there’s a noticeable food smell inside the restaurant.

Overall, it’s my favorite Spanish restaurant in the city so far, and I will definitely be coming back.

This is my favourite restaurant in Bucharest for the spanish dishes, especially paella, and because they maintained the quality of food over the years. The food was delicious, with quality ingredients. The desserts were a little too sweet for my taste.
But I was very disappointed about the service last time I visited. The lady who took our order seemed to be on the run every time we interacted,  did not offer any recommendation and I felt like I was disturbing her with my questions or additions to the initial order: like ordering another bottle of water or a coffee.
The most unpleasant surprise came with the bill. Without asking me, they have included  in the bill a 10% tip and brought us the bill at the table with the tip included. Not even when she brought the bill, she did not mention anything about 10% tip as being already included. And I paid the bill by card for the total amount, not noticing the tip added abusively.
And I offered also a 10% tip in cash, because that’s the minimum tip I usually offer if I enjoy the food and services. And I liked the food, despite the rush in attitude of the waitress.
Of course I paid the 10% tip calculated to the total amount already paid by card…
It is not mainly a matter of amount, it is a mater of fact. I felt that they robbed me intentionally, counting on my lack of attention. And I considered this a complete lack of respect for the client.
But, I would give second chances to this restaurant, as the food is great and I do hope that they will improve their service and consideration for their clients.
Me on my side, I will check carefully the bill and sanction any future discrepancy 10 times harder, in reviews. Which I do recommend to any client reading this.

The food is really, really good, and that’s coming from someone who grew up in Spain, it’s 1-1 with what you get there. The paella was delicious, just like every time I’ve been here. The staff is super professional and friendly, and the place totally teleports you to southern Spain for a few hours. I wholeheartedly recommend it! (and let’s not forget the tapas and the complimentary bizcocho de limon we got from the house)

Delicious Spanish food. The atmosphere is nice, cozy, with natural flowers and plants, semi dark warm light , excellent for a relaxed atmosphere. The service was excellent! Christian was very kind, professional and friendly. I definitely recommend this place. I return to this place again and again.

“Authentic Spanish flavors in the heart of Bucharest!”
I visited Casa España by Alioli and was genuinely impressed — the food was excellent, beautifully presented, and full of authentic Spanish taste. The atmosphere is warm and elegant, and the staff were attentive without being intrusive. Highly recommend the paella and sangria!

We were unexpectedly obliged to stay overnight in Bucharest after our flight was cancelled due to a snowstorm. We checked into the MyContinental hotel, where the staff recommended a restaurant just across the street.

From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by our waiter — and also talented painter — Ciprian. He suggested we try the local beer, Zăganu, which turned out to be an excellent recommendation. Absolutely delicious.

We were served nuts to start, and we quickly noticed the fun local custom: everyone simply drops the shells on the floor. It adds to the relaxed and authentic atmosphere.

The paintings on the walls are impressive and give the place real character. For dinner, we chose the lamb tenderloin with grilled vegetables — perfectly cooked and full of flavor.

A genuinely great place to go if you’re in Bucharest. Warm service, great food, and a memorable atmosphere.

Great food, unpretentious and delicious. Nice service, friendly staff. Aaaannnnd...
The best bit is that you're being served generous amounts of nuts and you're encouraged to throw the husks on the floor. Which is way more fun than you think.

Food was very delicious, the staff was warm and welcoming - although during the eating we felt eyes behind our back - maybe a staff was a little bit too welcoming. The food was perfectly seasoned, balanced, the drinks were stunning and fantastic! And don’t bother the mess - because nutshells must be on the floor! Thank you so much for having us 🩷

The best quality-price ratio in town. I recommend the lamb tenderloin, very fine grilled meat and the Grivitei lamb shank with cheese and garlic, also very delicious. The waiters score maximum 5*. Overall I recommend.

Excellent service and delicious food! One weird, quirky thing - they serve peanuts and you are supposed to throw the shells straight on the floor. Pretty weird and it felt unnatural at the beginning, but somehow fun.

name: La Mița Biciclista
address: Strada Biserica Amzei 9, Strada General Christian Tell 11, București, Romania

reviews.text:
This is a very coveted place.

The ambiance is nice, the spaces are elegant and it looks quite clear that they pay attention to detail.

The service is speedy and polite, our waiter was lovely.

I do object to the food however, the onion soup lacked salt and acidity. When I asked for balsamic vinegar I was told they have none. That was a dish prepared incorrectly from a technical standpoint.

I also got a Croque Monsieur and while it tasked ok, the bechamel sauce was on the inside. The Croque Monsieur varies as a recipe but always, ALWAYS, has cheese on top that was grilled if not both bechamel and cheese. It is not a usual sandwich and I don't bother making it at home which is why I order it in restaurants.

The bechamel being inside and the whole sandwich lacking grilled cheese on top was a glaring shortcut on part of Mita Biciclista and again, technically incorrect.

Also a disappointment given their French pretentions, which are many and somewhat unfounded.

At least stop calling it a Croque Monsieur, no one is making you have that on the menu.

The truffle omelet was nice and well prepared.

We also took the Paris Brest and the Vanille Fleur cakes, which were both nice, especially the Vanille Fleur, which was delicate and had a nice balance of flavors and textures.

The coffee was nice too.

All in all, if you tolerate shortcuts and maybe don't have the expectation that all of your dishes are made correctly from a technical standpoint you will like it.

Top restaurant in a historic building offering great quality food and drinks. We had the cheese platter, the scallops and the steak - all very tasty. Staff is well trained and attentive. The top floor restaurant is very stylish and better suited for romantic and quiet dinners than family dinners (we had a toddler with us and decided the place is too nice for a kid but the staff were kind enough to not mention it). The little balconies are so cute. Reservations highly recommended.

I came here too often! One of the best places--in Bucharest--for breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner, or supper! Not to mention the beautifully historic building where this restaurant is located. For breakfast, I highly recommend the truffle omelette and the praline pastry. For meals outside breakfast hours, the roasted chicken with baby potatoes is an absolute must-try. Unfortunately, in some seasons they have to substitute the baby potatoes with ratatouille or other sides, which in my opinion are not as good. The chicken, the creamy, buttery sauce, and the baby potatoes are a perfect match and complement each other wonderfully!

I was passing by and decided go in for some snack and coffee. The overall ambiance is really nice, good food and fancy dishware and even tiny attention to tiny spoons. Only thing I found disliking is the attitude of one of the staff members who showed us to the table. Dude, you simply cannot ne that arrogant in 2025 while working there. Some customer service training would not hurt this otherwise really nice place. Sell me, make ne feel like a valued customer, Ceaușescu is long gone come to the 2025 and adapt. All the best to management. Cheers

Lovely place - the service is great. The French onion soup is very delicious, the other things that we ordered were not as good as we expected based on the price but overall it’s a great place to have a French experience in Romania

name: Animaletto Pizza Bar
address: Strada I.C. Visarion 10 Parter, 010424 București, Romania

reviews.text: Honestly It was one of the best pizzas in my life, I didn’t expect that and I’m so happy that we found this place. It was totally worth going there and we highly recommend that restaurant. Everything that we ordered was delicious, staff were very friendly and english-speaking.

This looks like a perfect place to talk and relax, especially with the cozy atmosphere inside. Unfortunately, the pizza my friend ordered was not that great, it came cold and dry, but my dish—tomato soup with cheese—was delicious. Ginger lemonade is very tasty too.

We stopped by without a reservation and managed to get a spot outside, which was nice and casual. The service was quick, and the pizzas came out fast and perfectly cooked: thin, crispy, and tasty.
That said, nothing really stood out in terms of flavor or uniqueness, it was simply a well made, classic pizza, good for a quick and satisfying meal if you’re in the area.

Great pizza, great vibe — perfect spot to chill with friends in Bucharest! 🍕✨

Loved the vibe at Animaletto Bar Pizza — such a cool and lively spot right in the city.
We tried several pizzas & shared them (Buffala, Prosciutto cotto, Salsiccia, and Diavola) and each one was full of flavor and perfectly baked.
The staff were quick and everything felt smooth and easy.

⭐️ It’s one of those places where you just want to hang out with friends, enjoy good food and good energy.
The atmosphere is nice and the pizza is very good. Very thin crust.

The food was great, no surprise Sushizen is one of the best Asian restaurants in Bucharest ✨
One of the best tempuras in the city (forgot to take a photo with all 3 pieces), the Zen menu was fulfilling and the sashimi was generous as well!
The chocolate mousse deserves a special nod, it was beyond delicious 😍
Who has never tried it, book a table now 📆
We will definitely come back!

Best sushi place in Bucharest, proper, fresh. Nice plating, consistent over time
Bit pricey…. And crammed table set-up
Great service! This location is a bit crowded, so it's not such a good idea for a date, but for a normal lunch, it's perfect!

The place looked great, it was a mix between traditional Japanese restaurant and new, reinvented 5 star restaurant.
We ordered ramen (without meat) it was decent, I'd give it an 8 out of 10. Not enough flavour, it might be a personal prefference, but it was quite bland.

Sushi was better, but the rolls were unevenly cut, some pieces being too big and needed 2 bites. Furthermore, the rice was a bit sticky, the rolls unfolding when trying to pick it up from the plate.

The drinks were decent, we had. Hugo and a Mojito.

Overall? I'd say a 7/10, not the best, but not the worst either. P.s. the pictures may look appealing, yet the taste is the one that matters 😉
We had the supreme sushi set which was really tasty. Desserts were ok.

I recently visited Pata Negra and it truly felt like a little slice of Spain. The atmosphere was warm and vibrant, with Spanish music playing and a cozy, lively vibe. I went with a big group and we ordered family style and tried a big variety of dishes: several tapas, a seafood and a duck paellas - everything was fresh and full of flavor. The ingredients seemed genuinely Spanish, and you could tell the owners care about authenticity.

Service was friendly overall, though I did notice some guests waiting a bit longer for their food. If you go on a busy evening, I’d recommend making a reservation and maybe sitting inside, since the outdoor area can get hot in summer.

Prices are mid to high, but for the quality and ambiance, I think it’s worth it. All in all, a great spot if you’re craving authentic Spanish food and a festive night out.

We made a reservation on the terrace, for two, on a Saturday evening. The place is perfect for a relaxing hot summer evening.
The gin cocktails recommended by the waiter were good.
The food was ok. I enjoyed the red sauce with the mashed potatoes from my plate and my boyfriend liked the shrimps.
The online menu needs to be updated and the English descriptions of the food items should be in sync with the Romanian ones.
The waiter's recommendation on food and drinks was a match for us, so thank you for that!

Amazing food! The paella and the octopus are simply the best in Bucharest, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The location is absolutely beautiful, creating a wonderful atmosphere for a perfect dining experience. Highly recommended!

One the best restaurants in the city and with the most authentic Spanish cuisine.
I adore Spanish cuisine and here I have experienced a bit of Spain ❤️
The atmosphere is nice, cozy, they have a great attention to detail - the service is impeccable.
The prices are on the higher side, but it’s worth once in a while.

This place is fantastic! The owner is also the chef so you can feel the passion and care in the food. Every time we came here it was amazing! They offered us complimentary home made digestives too. Highly recommended!

Organised a small family and friends gathering with Ema’s help. She is the heart and soul of the place. Every guest was impressed by the food and the atmosphere, and felt like home. Ema helped us with the flower and table arrangements, the seating plan, or even small details like a phone charger or an advil for some
of our guests. Definitely my go-to option or strong recommendation for medium gatherings, as the restaurant’s capacity is of ca. 28 attendees. Maybe a cocktail format could allow more guests. The first 2 photos and the video are not from the day of the event.
Cute family owned spot in the middle of the city. Quiet and intimate, with a cozy atmosphere. I keep returning , definitely recommend for coffee/brunch/cocktails

The most amazing place, in beautiful French inspired town.  The staff was incredible.  The place is warm and welcoming, the food was fantastic and the coffee was just as great! The pouched eggs are probably the best I’ve ever had! The bacon nice and crispy and the avocado extremely fresh!

I highly recommend a visit, you won’t be disappointed!

It was so good we kept going back!
To the team there thank you so much!

Cute place with friendly people. I felt very posh when they brought my coffee in a glass cup. The waiter was very courteous.
I ordered an asparagus salad and what i got was two mediocrely cooked sunny side up eggs sitting on a few asparagus stalks and some zucchini. I wouldn’t call that a salad, and I wouldn’t have ordered it if I knew what it was.
Everything else was nice.  Not the place to go with your laptop to do work, because they don’t have internet for guests.

A quint place for brunch. Quite a varied menu with breakfast items. You can also go there for lunch or dinner, but the menu is not as attractive. There's no particular theme on the cuisine (pasta, fish, quesadilla, schnitzel etc). The food is ok, nothing special to mention about it. The atmosphere/design of the terrace is French, but can be tidier. The service was quick, and the staff is helpful. The beverage prices are very high, while the food ones are average for the area.
Great place ! Perfect for group  events  and also for nice gatherings. Very intimate and with a warm atmosphere. Food also great . Great value for money overall
Thank you for wonderful experiences! We are always happy to return here!
Pleasant and cozy location for short meetings and quick bites. Great coffee and very polite owner.
Nice enviroment, very good food, friendly people around you! Awesome!
Nice place. Personel very service minded.

​The ambiance and service were outstanding—truly five-star. However, the food was disappointing; the dishes were only decent and didn't justify the slightly expensive price point. I would return for the atmosphere, but not the cuisine.

Good experience, excellent service and food ok. Pasta was too salty, however once mentioned the waiter returned with a prosecco glass from the house. Also very amabile the entire time. Big plus also the possibility to order/ pay through the app and to use the 10% back points from previous locations part of city grill group, which are quite a lot :). Overall 4 stars, would be 4.5, but more inclined to 4 that to 5, due to the food quality. Still tried only pasta with a salat. Let’s see next order
Super nice restaurant, located in an amazing house. I guess that the food should be tasty, but carbonarra was average, a litle bit untasty.

We celebrated our daughter Rayssa’s birthday at Buongiorno and everything was perfectly organized from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making it an ideal place for a special occasion.

A special thank you to Bogdan for the excellent service. Attentive, professional, and always present without being intrusive. He truly helped make the evening smooth and enjoyable.

The girls absolutely loved the experience, the food was great, and the entire event felt effortless thanks to the team. Highly recommended for celebrations if you want things handled properly and your guests to leave happy.
Impeccable service, waitress always smiling and very efficient

name: Nuba Cafe
address: Strada Locotenent Aviator Radu Beller 13, 011701 București, Romania

reviews.text: The day before was pretty good with the waitres. The waiter that was on early shift 03.03.26. was very rude. Wasn't closing the doors on the outside bubble. The smoothies where made mostly from ice, was not drincable. Gave us closed options on what could order without explanation, unlike the waitres the day before. Two day two different xp :(

A Wonderful Experience at Nuba Cafe

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Nuba Cafe, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The ambiance was cozy and inviting, making it the perfect spot for a relaxing meal. The menu offered a delightful selection of fresh and flavorful dishes, each prepared with care and attention to detail. The highlights were their signature dishes, which truly stood out for their unique blends of spices and high-quality ingredients.

What made the experience even more memorable was the outstanding service provided by Marian. From the moment we arrived, Marian greeted us with a warm smile and made us feel right at home. He was attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and offered great recommendations. His friendly demeanor and prompt service made the meal even more enjoyable.
I highly recommend Nuba Cafe to anyone looking for great food and top-notch service. With a welcoming atmosphere and staff like Marian, it’s definitely a place I’ll be returning to soon.

good service, good food, but still not a culinary experience, just luxurious looking
had two plates: one was amazing, the other was ok with mixed feelings

the vibe of the place is really nice

That is a beautiful spot in this posh area with a style and several different service people.  Some are bored some very kind so it happens. The Asian beef salad was perfect with a glass of wine and the Savarin was great,  generous and tender with rum. Coffee was a nice end of the stop before leaving Bucharest. I would highly recommend it but take care as the prices are really high. Bathroom is worth for a visit especially if you are a mosaic person.

We visited for a late brunch and were pleased to find that breakfast is served until 3 PM. The food was excellent, featuring fresh vegetables and a variety of vegan, gluten-free, and sugar-free options. We especially recommend the avocado toast with pink hummus (a vegan option) and the truffle eggs with cheese and French fries. Additionally, the freshly made desserts are something you should try.
The service was great. Our waiter, Marian, was quick, attentive, and impressively memorized the order for our group of five. Although they initially brought me the wrong coffee, they promptly corrected the mistake, and everything else went smoothly.
The only downside is that indoor smoking is allowed, which might be uncomfortable for some.
Overall, it's a great spot for brunch, and we highly recommend it!

name: KETOLICIOUS
address: Piata Presei Libere 3-5, Turnul de Sud, parter, latura de nord, spatiul 3, 013702 București, Romania

reviews.text:
A gem of a find in bucharest! Less than 30 mins ride on the 100 bus stop from outside the departures at Henri Conda Int Airport (beware the traffic in rush hour). I visited Therme Spa which I found dissapointing for so many reasons but this eatery was a huge redemption. A very progressive and wonderful business that very much reflects Romania in general (in my humble opinion). I like so many others I know have made huge lifestyle changes to  stay clear of diabetes and other metabolic disease as well as staying clear of sugar is making me look younger.
I had a pizza that was very tasty and filling , the dough was firm but not stodgy and the toppings were delicious and well baked, and I could actually taste real cheese! Wow! I did not have enough time to sample every other pizza and believe me there were many options there were delicios looking bagels and the cake selection was the most impressive. I had the tiramisu and it was heaven, better than any non keto version by a mile. I also took away the snickers bar which i have not gotten around to eating but it was a huge portion and looks simply decadent.
With wizz air offering cheap flights i will plan future trips back to bucharest as a base for futher Romania travels and i hope to stay within reasonable distance of this place so I can actually eat well without compromising my health.

An extremely friendly and competent couple who make amazing gluten free food. The quiche and brioche tasted fresh and flavourfull. The lemon cake was the best one I have eaten in general! Deffinetly a restaurant worth visiting!

Bought some sugar free cookies, and I observed no increase in blood glucosis.
Snickers type is a really tasty one.
The best place în Bucharest to get your keto food. Highly recommended!!!
Very, very delicious keto food and amazing hosts!!!

name: Hard Rock Cafe Bucharest
address: Şoseaua Pavel D. Kiseleff 32, 011343 București, Romania

reviews.text: Great experience at Hard Rock Cafe Bucharest! The atmosphere is amazing, especially for music lovers, with great rock vibes . The food was really tasty and the portions were good. The prices are a bit on the higher side, but honestly the whole experience, the quality of the food, and the unique atmosphere make it worth it. The staff was also very friendly and helpful. Definitely a place you should visit at least once when you’re in Bucharest!

Had my birthday celebration here in August. One of the best Hard Rock Cafe I’ve ever visited! The Bucharest Romanian Burger was to die for so was the local beer. The service was brilliant, I absolutely adored the robot-dish collector, he was cute and very efficient, never seen it anywhere else.
The place had a stage and life music. The concert that night was fantastic and the acoustic was perfect.
The place presents British artists at a special level, which I found amazing.
The cafe has rather a round shape, it helps when you want to look around without missing anything.
There’s a gorgeous lake and a pretty park next to the cafe.
We had a lovely walk after we left and finished our evening beautifully.

A really unique and beautiful place in Bucharest. For those who like rock music and legend icons is a must to visit. They also host lives from different bands. I had the opportunity to discuss for a bit with Ioana, who works there, she is such a happy and polite person. Thank you very much making my night there a really nice experience!!

Amazing! Hard rock gives the real American food and atmosphere. If you're a fan of that, this is the place for you! I think prices are fair and the staff is amazing. Just entering this restaurant you will feel back in times in an American restaurant and that's the good side of it! The BBQ ribs are a MUST TRY! In all fairness don't expect the world, however I think the food is really nice and the vibe of that place is a huge win! I am recommending it to everyone.
If you're driving there the good thing is it has a huge parking with lots of spaces, the bad thing - it is paid.

We visited the cafe as we do usually in every city we visit. We enjoyed the park in front of the cafe which on any regular day with some sun attracts many visitors and is very nice for a stroll. The cafe itself is nicely decorated, we liked especially the bar to drink our bloody marry. The food, burgers, and beef fajitas are delicious. Shop personnel and service is excellent and friendly. One of the few restaurants you can say where atmosphere is great. You can reach the place easily with uber, taxi or even metro in front; or your own car but there is not much parking.

name: 18Lounge
address: City Gate - South Tower, Piața Presei Libere 3-5, 18th Floor, 013702 București, Romania

reviews.text: An amazing experience, as expected! The food is amazing (the shrimp salad and the chicken breast were very tasty, and the lava cake and creme brulee were as sweet as they had to), and the staff is also very helpful, especially Mihai, who helped us. Can’t wait to come back!

18 Lounge is a place that impresses not only through its atmosphere, but also through the quality of its food. I visited the lounge for a meal and was pleasantly surprised by the attention given to flavors, presentation, and overall dining experience.

The menu is well thought out, offering a balanced selection of dishes that feel both modern and comforting. The food was fresh, well-seasoned, and carefully prepared, clearly showing that quality ingredients are a priority. Each plate was beautifully presented, turning the meal into a visual as well as a culinary experience. Portions were satisfying, and the combination of textures and flavors felt refined without being pretentious.

The atmosphere of the lounge adds a lot to the experience. The elegant interior, comfortable seating, and relaxed ambiance make it an excellent choice for a quiet dinner, a business lunch, or a relaxed evening with friends. Even without ordering alcoholic drinks, the experience felt complete and enjoyable.

Service was another strong point. The staff was polite, attentive, and professional, making sure everything was in order without being intrusive. Overall, 18 Lounge is a great choice if you are looking for a place where good food, a pleasant atmosphere, and quality service come together naturally.

Worth a visit for a special meal, slightly higher prices but still very reasonable. Great views, a little out the way and on an office block building. Make sure you use Uber or Bolt if getting transport too and from venue

I had a great time at 18 Lounge. The atmosphere was stylish and relaxing, the music was at a perfect level, and the drinks were really well made. A special thank you to Cătălina, our waitress — she was friendly, attentive, and professional, and made sure we had everything we needed without being intrusive. Service was fast, the recommendations were on point, and we felt genuinely welcomed. I’ll definitely come back and I highly recommend this place!

The place is so cozy lovely, and nice, only one person in service, but still it wasn’t that big of a deal, we had  pasta bloglines and it was so good, the service tip is optional now of u want, u can if you don’t want it’s not mandatory

name: Zaitoone
address: Str. Nicolae G. Caramfil 2, 014143 București, Romania

reviews.text: The food was excellent and the service impeccable — the waiters were friendly, attentive, and very professional. Unfortunately, the experience was affected by the restaurant management allowing some guests to smoke inside, even though the legal conditions for doing so are clearly not met under Romanian law. It’s disappointing to see such a well-run place overlook this aspect, as it impacts the comfort of all non-smoking customers.

I have eaten Lebanese all my life, and my father and uncles were all born in Beirut. This was sensational, the fattoush and tabbouleh were amazing, such authentic flavours easy to get wrong. The breads, the houmous, the babaghanoush, all amazing. And great service.

The best Lebanese restaurant in Romania‼️‼️ 🇷🇴
I love the food … and where I try in the world… believe me here is the best 🥰
Location is super clean and classy, shisha also top
The best truffle hummus in town. Top shisha and atmosphere with good music. All the food is delicious. I love that smoking is allowed indoors.

Beautiful a place with a nice service, we arrived late direct from airport and they welcome us nicely
The food was excellent and service too
The shisha was top too

Best coffee shop @ Piața Presei Libere
They have fresh pastry and a lot of fresh juices and greek yogurt with muesli & fruit all the time.
This place has the wrong category! There is no gas pump here, only the corporate office of Rompetrol
good fuel, friendly staff
The HVAC has issues...
Very good and nice!

name: Shuyu 蜀渔 Herastrau Peking Duck 北京烤鸭 & Hot Pot 火锅
address: Şoseaua Pavel D. Kiseleff 32, 011343 București, Romania

reviews.text: Super elegant new spot for Chinese hot pot. Friendly staff, highly recommended.

Environment: Clean and elegant with friendly, attentive service.

Food: I highly recommend the mild spicy (微辣) hotpot. The broth is flavourful and becomes even richer and more intense as it simmers throughout the meal. A side added fried rice will be a perfect match.

Sauce Bar: There is an impressive variety of choices at the sauce bar, including sesame sauce, chili oil, crushed peanuts, fresh coriander, and more.

Advantage: Location is much convenient than the Fundeni Shuyu. Take a stroll at the lakeside is great after a feast!
Highly recommended. We lived in Beijing, and my favorite dish is Peking duck. The staff is very friendly, and the duck was perfect. Be sure to try some dim sum as well. You won't regret it.

It has a  nice welcoming ambience, food with a nice mix of flavours and a good variety of dishes.
A bit bigger portions on the meat would make a good balance flavour / size/ price
Good for drinks, and a nice experience with friends or family

Some dishes may be better, but the grilled beef with zucchini was nothing special. It was barebones, just a few slices of beef and a few vegetables. No sauce, no nothing. They have an electronic ordering system and I was 100% sure I added the lava cake desert to the order, but when I asked a waitress she said she doesn't see it in the order. However, just when I went to the bar to pay, another waitress was bringing the lava cake. Only a few tables were occupied but we still had to wait a lot for the food, and they didn't bring the 2 dishes at once, so we could both eat. Quite a poor experience. Doesn't compare with the richness of ingredients found in thai food. Also, the portions are small, but the prices are not.

Finding a place that feels just like home is a rare and wonderful treasure when traveling. Taverna Sârbului captured that authentic Serbian spirit perfectly, from the rustic wooden interior to the warm, traditional decorations. The atmosphere was incredibly welcoming, making it the ideal spot to relax and enjoy a soulful meal. The star of the show was undoubtedly the steak, which arrived sizzling on a hot stone and was seasoned to perfection. Every bite of the meat was tender and packed with the bold, smoky flavors we’ve been craving. Even the side dishes, like the fresh cabbage salad, felt like they came straight from a family kitchen. To top it all off, the dessert was a delightful blend of sweetness and fresh fruit that rounded out the experience. The service was attentive and friendly, adding to the genuine hospitality that defines Serbian culture. It was a 10/10 experience that provided much more than just a meal; it provided a true taste of home.

For those nostalgic for the past and tradition, Taverna Sârbului can be an alternative if you are looking for traditional dishes.

The atmosphere was calm, with live music, and the staff did their best to be kind and helpful.

The food was not impressive, though this is a matter of taste.
Food is good but service staff's attitude is not friendly. Maybe we should tip them first before we order and before we eat? Pity such poor attitude spoils the otherwise nice restaurant

Lovely spot with a beautiful terrace, tastefully decorated down to the details. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a great place to linger. The food was excellent—full of flavor and generously portioned. My only small note is about the Kaizer: while the portion was huge, it was sliced paper-thin, almost like bacon. Thicker cuts would have really let the flavor shine through. Still, overall, a very satisfying and enjoyable experience.
There's plenty to choose from the menu!

We came here 10 years ago, and it is still as wonderful as we remember.  The food was great and Christina (our waitress) was very patient with our large party of 10
People.  Highly recommend.

Sunny day, good vibe, bad service…
I asked for a soup and a burger to be served in the same time, and the soupwas brought after 10-15 minutes. Then the bottle of water. Then the glasses for the water. And finally the burger with the fries. At least the food was decent
Been here today in a group of 4. Service provided by Nabin Fixx was perfect. Always polite and attentive. The food was amazing, the cocktails well mixed and beer fresh from the tap.

Best service ever!!!! Thank you Nabin Fixx!!!! We loved our lunch and your service. Absolutely spot on. And lovely to hear you speak Romanian so well. Congratulations! We will definitely come back again soon thanks to you. More staff should be like you ❤️

We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, and everything was fresh and perfectly cooked. The service was very friendly and fast, which made our visit even more enjoyable.
Our waitress, Rodica, was extremely kind and sweet. She made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived and took great care of us throughout the meal.
We highly recommend the beef schnitzel – it was outstanding and definitely a must-try!
We will gladly come back again.
Food was delicious and the service provided by Lorena was excellent. She was very attentive and helped us with the perfect recommendations.

name: Stadio Park
address: Herastrau Park, Șoseaua Nordului 7-9, 014101 Bucharest, Romania

reviews.text: The best experience in Bucharest 🥰 The food was delicious and in great quantity. The prices reflect directly the quality of products and services. Paul, our waiter, was super friendly and helped us make the best decisions for our dinner.

The restaurant has a very nice atmosphere and the waiters are very nice, we got paloma which was nice but not that good compared to other places, the pizza tutti salomi was very good, the truffel fries were very very mid and also the burger, the turkey sticks were oke also overall very mid.

The place looks very nice and has a big garden. Good and pretty fast service. The pasta was good, but the breaded turkey strips was super dry overly fried and very hard to cut or chew. For paying 70lei for that is disappointing.
And the famous papanasi balls were not well cooked, felt like the dough inside was kinda raw.
Overall a nice place, but they should pay more attention to the dishes.
Paul was an excellent waiter, friendly and he also made espresso martini possible even though it was not on the drink menu. Very happy. Place is also beautiful.

Burger could have been better. The name says it's famous but honestly it was mediocre. The terrace atmosphere and service was decent. The price corresponds with the area where the restaurant is located but not necessarily with the expected above average quality of the dishes.

Given that this is part of a big chain of restaurants of all sorts including City Grill, Caru' cu Bere and Hanul Berarilor, I came expecting mediocrity. However I was actually pleasantly surprised at least by the Carbonara which is my usual litmus test for Italian food. They used the correct ingredients and mostly the correct preparation though the spaghetti was a little overcooked by Italian standards but perfect for my father who actually ordered the dish. My pizza was nothing to complain about and neither were the penne quatro frommagi but both felt like there was a little something missing. Still overall I would say you could certainly do worse, even in horrible tourist areas of Italy so it may be worth giving a shot.

Great Italian spot with a warm, elegant atmosphere. We had the pizza, eggplant salad with Parmesan, and focaccia , everything was fresh, flavorful, and very well made. High-quality ingredients, authentic Italian taste, and professional, welcoming service. A lovely place for a relaxed and satisfying meal.

We had an amazing experience at this restaurant! The food was absolutely excellent, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was just as impressive, the staff were attentive, kind, and went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed.

We came with two small kids, and the team did everything possible to make us feel comfortable. They were patient, accommodating, and made the whole experience stress-free and enjoyable for the whole family.
Highly recommended.  We’ll definitely be coming back!
I ordered the carbonara and it was amazing! The waiter Ajay was really helpful and kind. I would definitely recommend to come here if you’re in Bucharest!⭐️

Wow what a delicious sea food dishes here….
Ajay did a great and professional job a big thanks to Ajay…. Highly recommended

Poesia – One of the Most Unique Restaurants in Bucharest

I had the pleasure of dining at Poesia in Bucharest on December 1st, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. Situated on the elegant Aviatorilor Avenue, this restaurant is set inside a beautifully restored old house, giving it a warm, charming, and sophisticated atmosphere. The interior is absolutely stunning – classic architecture meets tasteful modern touches, making it one of the most visually impressive dining spots in Bucharest.

The food at Poesia is equally exceptional. Every dish is thoughtfully prepared, fresh, and bursting with flavor. From the carefully crafted starters to the perfectly executed main courses, everything was a delight both in taste and presentation. The service was excellent – professional, attentive, and friendly, creating a seamless and enjoyable dining experience.

Overall, Poesia offers more than just a meal; it’s a full experience combining exquisite cuisine, elegant ambiance, and top-notch service. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply looking for a refined night out in Bucharest, Poesia stands out as one of the city’s most unique and memorable restaurants. I highly recommend it and can’t wait for my next visit!

Simply amazing from the service, food and atmosphere, all in a cozy designed reataurant.
Food was simply amazing, in top 2 meals so far this year.
We’ll 100% visit again.

Lovely location. Great food. The service can br deffinitelly improved. Our waiter didn't want to take the order for the starters because we have not decided yet the main course. And this was really unpolite.

Really good seafood, especially the shrimp carpaccio. The beef fillet was nice, but not as impressive as the seafood or pasta. The restaurant is nice as well, it’s much better on the terrace in nice weather. I’ve been here a few times, and I’ve noticed that the inside staff tends to be a bit less attentive and a bit more negligent. I’m really nitpicking here, as I want this place to keep up the good work.

We went there on a Saturday evening. It's easy to get there from the Aviatorilor subway. We went around 7PM, with reservation. At 8PM it gets crowded.
The place is very nice, warm, inviting.
They don't have any cocktails or beer, being an italian restaurant. They only have water and different types of wine.

The music was ok and the volume was set ideally, not to hear clearly the conversations around, but still allowing us to talk normally and understand each other.

I appreciated that they brought us a starter on the house: two types of butter (very good the one with the truffles), olives and 4 types of bread (the round one and the slices of the white bread were very much enjoyed).

The food was good, personally I think that the green pepper sauce for the meat could have been more fresh (speaking of taste) and hot (also speaking of taste) and the green leaf used to decorate the meat dish overpowered the sauce, at least.
The fries were perfect.

It was a pleasant experience. We enjoyed ourselves. Cheers!

The food at Seper is delicious, home-cooked and made with love. The prices are absolutely reasonable. The service is excellent, especially for so many people. And the barista, a brunette with glasses, made me a very, very, very tasty coffee. Great! I ate here and took some with me.

A canteen style restaurant which serves the office workers nearby. I ate there twice. The first time I tried the grilled fish with some mashed corn which were very tasty. The second time I tried the Spanish seafood rice which was terrible. But price was good.
Good food fair price, almost fine dining

The food is freaking tasty, not that expensive, but also not that fresh. It's okay to eat it here from time to time, but my liver has a hard time whenever I eat my lunch here. I may have some kind of sensibility, even though KFC and Burgers don't give me the same sensation 😅👍🏻.

Other than that, all good.
A good place to eat in the afternoon for people working nearby. It is structured as a buffet, the food is good and varied. The prices are decent considering the area.

We love this restaurant! The food is very tasty, the staff is considerate, the view is amazing, and there is live music or a DJ. The restaurant is located in Herăstrău Park, so you can go for a nice walk after dinner. It's also perfect for events, and they have a generous wine list.
We had a pleasant company dinner at Pescaruș, enjoying the spacious high ceilings, live music, and attentive warm service. Its elegant atmosphere and flavors made our evening truly enjoyable.

We recently had the pleasure of performing with our band at Restaurant Pescăruș, and it was a truly memorable experience. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and professionalism by the staff and management. The venue is beautifully located by the lake, offering a picturesque setting that adds charm and elegance to any event.

The acoustics and technical setup were excellent, allowing us to deliver our performance in the best possible conditions. The staff was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the evening. It’s always a joy to sing in a place where both the audience and the team appreciate live music and create a vibrant atmosphere.

As for the food – absolutely delicious! The menu is rich in fresh fish and seafood dishes, all beautifully presented and full of flavor. Guests were clearly enjoying not just the ambiance, but also the culinary experience.

Restaurant Pescăruș is the perfect combination of fine dining, natural beauty, and a welcoming vibe for live events. We’re looking forward to coming back – whether to perform again or simply to enjoy a lovely evening by the water.

Highly recommended for both private events and casual outings!

Food was excellent, great service from Alexandru a great character, paid great attention to my special requests on my burger and always had a smile on his face. Great location, and the mango sorbet was the best I’ve ever had 10/10 recommend.
Great place, delicious food and very kind staff in special Andrei was very attentive and helpful.

name: Beraria H Herastrau
address: Kiseleff, "King Michael I" Park, fostul Pavilion H, Alee Principală Herăstrău 32, 011343 București, Romania

reviews.text: They have nice events, but the sound is not great. The outdoor one is better than the indoor one. Food is ok, but could be definitely better, especially since there's nothing too sophisticated on the menu. Quite pricy for what you get. Friendly service, but slow when they have large events.
The place is huge and the decoration is  nice; the food is delicious and abundant; really good beer! the servers were very nice. I have to come at night, as Ifeel they have great parties.

Explosive experience at Berăria H!
We had an absolute blast! The soups? Genius—no comments needed, just wow. The pork ribs, burgers, and schnitzel were massive and delicious. Everything was spot on. The house amber unfiltered beer was superb—smooth, flavorful, unforgettable.
Service was great (Nora gets a solid 10!), and we’ll definitely be back soon.

Highly recommend for anyone craving bold flavors and good vibes.
It s an incredible place. Every night with an event, even two events per day. Very crowded although it is a very spacious place. It s crazy 😀😀😀
Good food, great atmosphere. Great place for celebration or meeting with friends and family. I loved their platters. Every week there is a different show.

A great steakhouse. We ordered the tomahawk steak and a Greek salad. The salad was good but not comparable to the meat, which was of extremely high quality and cooked to perfection, together with a nice fire show 😁. By default, the steak was paired with a red wine sauce, which was good, but I also added the peppercorn sauce and liked it even better. It was nice, though not the highlight of the meal.

Since my partner for the 1.2 kilo steak was 11 years old, I asked them to warm the steak, and they quickly brought it back on another cast iron plate. Thanks to that, I enjoyed the steak until the very last bite.

Had a very good dinner. The place is big, very clean. Excellent service. The food was of a good taste. The starters were excellent. The chicken wings were tasty and juicy. The steak sandwich was a bit dry but the meat was very good. The fact that they allow smoking inside the main hall of the restaurant was a bit disturbing. Overall very recommended!

OSHO stands out with its beautiful interior and excellent selection of beef from around the world. We ordered a steak and a Wagyu beef burger. The steak was perfectly cooked, exactly the way we wanted it, and the burger was really juicy and tasty. The staff was polite, though a bit nonchalant.

Unfortunately, a big downside was the constantly open doors between the patio and the indoor area, which let cigarette smoke drift inside. It really spoiled the dining experience — our clothes and hair ended up smelling like smoke.

Very good experience with polite waiters.
Kinda expensive but you can tell just by looking at the place so not a shocker.
The food was AMAZING.
It's worth a visit if you are willing to spend a bit money.
One of the best steakhouses in Bucharest! Worth the high reviews! Good food, nice location and kind staff!

We stumbled upon this place by accident, but it turned out to be a great find. Friendly service, reasonable prices, and the food was seriously delicious. I especially recommend the goulash and the pork ribs with baked potatoes.

I visited this restaurant with an international group of friends. We had a reservation for 12 people, but 16 eventually arrived. While I understand the place is quite narrow, it didn’t look completely full, yet they refused to accommodate our additional friends.

The food was generally OK. The lasagne would have benefited from some béchamel sauce, the pizza was appreciated by my friends, and my cheesecake tasted a bit too “industrial” for my taste.

What really ruined the experience was the attitude of the staff. It’s the first time in my life that I’ve been insistently asked to pay and leave at 22:45 — on a Saturday night in Bucharest. The feeling was very unpleasant and unwelcoming.

Overall, decent food but poor customer service. I wouldn’t return.
Very good pasta and perfect papanas! Kind staff, decent prices, quick service. I will be back.

Best food in town! Best crew in town!
(Tania, Marcel, Razvan, Cristi, Bianca)

I had a wonderful experience at this Italian restaurant. The atmosphere was cozy and authentic, making you feel like you’re in Italy from the moment you walk in.

The food was absolutely delicious — the pasta was perfectly cooked, the pizza had a thin, crispy crust, and the ingredients tasted fresh and high quality. You can really tell that everything is made with care.

The staff was friendly, attentive, and helpful with recommendations, which made the experience even better. Service was quick without feeling rushed.

Best pasta I've had in Romania, bar none.

I've had food that wasn't pasta here before and it was great but not memorable.

Tonight I've tasted the pasta and it was the best pasta I've had outside of Italy.

Tortellini we're great, skillet was super hot and took 10 min to cool down, don't order if really hungry, but awesome taste if you can be patient. 8/10

Penne quattro formaggi was great but a touch too much gorgonzola for my taste. 9/10.

Caesar salad with schnitzel, it's more schnitzel than salad (literally a plate sized schnitzel topped with salad). Caesar dressing was minimal. 7.5/10

Pappardelle was far and away the best dish, probably the best in the whole menu and definitely the best pasta I've had outside of Italy. 10/10.

We were guests at a wedding here. It was really fun, their food was great, the desserts buffet had lots of delicious options to choose from. The staff is very fun and nice. Really recommend. The only problem is they cut and burned a goat right in front of us on a stick above the fire.

Hosted an event here and everything was great. People are very communicative, always ready to help, and the service was great. They adapted to all requests in terms of food and drinks, let us decorate the location to our needs. Also received the different elements and arranged them as we agreed. Location was great, the terrace on the bank of the Herăstrău Lake, food was great, service very good (no complaints whatsoever from anyone). All in all, I highly recommend it.
Loved the place, food and presentation.
We dine at lake lounge. It is a stunning place by the pier with fantastic lake view. Service was ok; the food very well presented; food quality was not impressive which dropped the overall ranking.
Great location overlooking the lake. Very tasty food
I had Granny’s pork sausage soup, and a hot latte. All were delicious.

This is a small cozy restaurant in a very beautiful location. The menu is not very diverse but it is extremely carefully chosen in order to address a wide range of customers. The meals we had were of very good quality and the service was OK. They also offer a very original desert collection of cakes that were originally designed over 100 years ago.

Indeed high quality desserts. We sampled 4 cakes and they were all very tasty, albeit very sweet.
The savory mushroom tart was also good.
High prices but good quality overall. Service is not great.

Beautiful cafe with healthy options. I sat outside in their step down outdoor area which was lovely. I had the cauliflower soup with the Romanian cheese which was just delicious and the tuna tartare which was fresh. Easy fulfilling lunch. Great service and songs as well. Came back the following day for an exotic pastry, it didn’t disappoint!
Excellent origin coffee shop. Warm atmosphere and very good coffee and tea.
Good Suitets and coffee.
Delicious sweets, friendly staff, nice terrace.
a really nice place to grab lunch or something sweet - very friendly staff and cozy atmosphere 🍰
Caesar salad with strong fish taste, average food, service was awful.
Amazing place! Amazing staff!

An interesting place in the park with a terrace on the lake. This is where the advantages end. The driest BBQ ribs you can imagine. There is no music in the hall and it feels like you are in a crowd where you can only hear the hum of conversations.

The worst meal I've had in Bucharest. The fish was dry, the salad was boring, the corn side dish was uninspired, and the white wine was warm. The French fries were okay, and the sauce was good. The waiter was friendly. Beautiful surroundings by the lake, but they deserve better food.
I was left with a bad feeling in my stomach for several hours.
fantastic place with beautiful view and the best papanasi!
Very, very good food and nice terrace! Super happy with the staff 💯
Very good food, fair price,nice view on the lake- especialy at sunset, top service

Absolutely fantastic panini spot.
I tried both the mortadella and the truffle panini, and they were outstanding – good quality ingredients, perfect bread, and really balanced flavors. The specialty coffee is also excellent and clearly made with care. The homemade classic tiramisu is a standout: fresh and authentic. Warm service, great atmosphere, and genuinely some of the best panini I’ve had in a long time. Highly recommended.
They have a very good panini. A great spot if you want a speciality coffee and something to eat. The service is outstanding and you must try their tiramisu ! It’s one of the best I’ve tried !
Delicious food and amazing coffee!🤩 I’ve already been a couple of times, and I cannot wait to go again! Note for future: please add some vegan options as well❤️
Best Tiramisu ever. Thanks a lot ❤️
Premium experience!!

Delicious pasta! 🤤 Made fresh after ordering. Big enough portion. Great service. The summer garden is cute, with sea side vibes.
I definitely recommend it!

Delicious food, and friendly staff.
We discovered you at Electric Castle and for sure we will visit you again and again in Bucharest.
We had the Fatty B and is amazing!
Thank you!
I ate a lot of mac and cheese in my life and this is definetely one of the best!! Would recommend for sure. Very creamy and cheesy. And nice staff!
Delicious comfort food and a very nice place to hang out and chill!
Delicious mac and cheese in the nice spot. Definitely worth to visit 🤤

The building is kind of strange and getting to the restaurant is strange but thats where the strangeness ends. The decor inside is pretty upscale, the stage and audio system are pro grade but more importantly, the food is fantastic! I had a delicious burger, amazing fries and a delicious garlic mayo dip. The staff looked after us well. Ill be back next time Im in town.

Absolutely one of the best burgers I've had!
The atmosphere is also perfect. Very relaxing, great music and decorated with style. Really awesome place to hang out. Will definitely come back soon.

The place is somewhat hidden in a business area but worth discovering. I had the double cheeseburger with fries and it was excellent. Modern loft ambiance and a great sound system. The service was friendly and efficient. I’ll definitely come back with friends or colleagues
Very good burger 🍔
Nice place, friendly personnel. The food was cold, the wine selection looks good. I will check it out again soon.

A nice Turkish atmosphere, with Turkish radio playing in the background.
Portions are very generous — when you order the large shawarma, you really get a huge plate for 56 lei.
I ordered around 10am and surprisingly, the service was fast. My only small complaint is about the meat, which was a bit dry and not as juicy as you’d usually expect. They offer plenty of sauces; I especially liked the tzatziki and the onion mayonnaise. The curry sauce, however, didn’t feel very strong or well-flavored.
Considering the location of the restaurant and the prices, I think it’s a good bargain.

4/5 for the food, it needs a slightly better taste, quality is where it should be.

5/5 overall experience

Good evening. I rarely write negative reviews, but this place truly deserves one.

The interior looks nice, and I often see many people here during the day, so I expected decent quality. What I received instead was complete disappointment.

The service was careless and indifferent. I ordered a tenderloin steak, a doner kebab, and fries. Everything was cold. Not slightly warm. Not room temperature. Cold — as if it had been sitting there for hours.

When I pointed this out, the staff looked confused, as if serving cold food in a “hot food” restaurant was completely normal. There was no apology, no professionalism, no urgency to fix the problem.

Let me be clear: people come to a Turkish doner place expecting freshly cut hot meat from the grill, warm bread, and crispy fries — not cold flatbread stuffed with pre-sliced meat taken from somewhere in the back. The fries were clearly old and reheated, if reheated at all.

This is not just bad service — this is disrespect toward customers. Serving cold food and pretending it is acceptable shows a complete lack of care.

I returned everything and left. I will never come back, and I will definitely not recommend this place to anyone.

If you decide to visit, check your food carefully. Otherwise, you may end up paying for something that feels like leftovers.

Very disappointing. Completely unacceptable.

This restaurant serves a good quality kebab and is conveniently located close to Promenada Mall. It's notably clean and offers plenty of seating options (inside and outside). The only drawback is that you should expect significant wait times during peak lunch hours.

First good parts and then bad part. Kebabs and meat cuts are great (grill area). The staff who work on the charcoal barbecue are doing great job. Atmosphere is also nice, comfortable and clean seating area. Portion size can be discussed separately since for example Adana kebab meat portion is really small. But overall, meat quality, charcoal grill taste, serving with salad and garnish are strong points.
Doner section with its own separate staff is where we had bad experience. We found several stretch film parts in the doner wrap. I attached photo. I dont know how exactly this plastic stretch foil got into doner but it is sign that the doner section needs more attention. Second bad experience here goes as follows. We asked for wrap only with meat and potatoes and a little bit of ketchup. When we saw that ketchup was too little we asked them to give us a bit more ketchup maybe in one of small containers because wrap was already done and there was no way to put ketchup inside it. One of the guys said extra sauce needs to be paid separately without knowing that we asked for just a little ketchup, we did not even get any salad and all we wanted was just a bit more sauce. The guy who knew it didn't intervene so I had to insist on it. It is ridiculous to ask client pay for the sauce that you didn't put...
Bottomline is that I recommend owner to assign an experienced doner master to manage this section as they did with barbecue section.
Turkish cousins are always so inviting specially kebabs 🤤😋

We recently visited this Iranian restaurant and overall had a good experience. The food was tasty, with generous portions and authentic flavors. The atmosphere was pleasant and lively, giving a true Middle Eastern vibe.

However, there were a few downsides. The toilets were extremely small and not very clean, which was a bit disappointing. The place is clearly popular — it was packed when we arrived, and we had to wait around 15–20 minutes for a table to clear. Also, toward the end of our meal, we felt a bit rushed when the staff asked if we were planning to leave soon so they could seat others waiting.

All in all, it’s a good restaurant with great food and ambiance, but the overall experience felt a bit too hectic for my taste. Probably worth trying once, but I wouldn’t hurry back.

A very cozy Persian restaurant (don’t confuse them with Arabs, as most people do!) with friendly staff! Food was outstanding and we couldn’t stop trying different dishes! In fact, we decided to come back soon in order to try out whatever we couldn’t do this time! And very generous servings, I should say!
I would give them 5 ⭐️, but we find the restroom in need of serious cleaning (we were in the evening, but frequent maintenance is mandatory if you want to stand out as a restaurant, and not as a fast-food joint!) and the smell of fried food that impregnated in our clothing (I guess the ventilation is not working properly)

We have been extremely impressed by the taste of the food. Everything has been absolutely delicious and worth it.
