The service was nice, respectful staff, had a good time overall. You are being asked if you need anything and not left to wonder or to wait and wait and wait.
There is background music and it is pretty good volume, does not bother and you can hear the other people that are with you at the table.
The place looks nice and it’s a pretty cozy vibe.

The menu includes calories and what ingredients you find, except for the ayran which has mint inside, which gives it an amazing taste, first time we tried and we were impressed!
Sublime, authentic food! Lovely service!Great experience overall! Will definitely come back for more!
Really delicious, the zereshk was prepared with rosewater, great service and hospitality. Delicious jujeh kabab and sholehzard. Authentic and prepared with love!

Its a small restaurant but The food is amazing. We searched for good food options for 2 days when finally we stumbled upon this hidden gem. Hands down best indian food i have had in Romania and highly recommended. Even if you are travelling from far, its right across the metro station making ideal for food lovers.

Highly recommended.

Highly recommend authentic Indian food.

The new offer is great with every curry one lacha paratha is complementary... This is limited time offer must avail.
Very cozy little restaurant with good food. We had the mix veg curry, the chicken tikka paratha roll and they gave us also a chicken samosa. Would warmly recommend!

Today I tried breakfast at Sana’s Kitchen and it was absolutely amazing. I had halwa puri, samosa, paratha with chana, and chai — everything was delicious and full of authentic flavor. While eating, I truly felt like I was back home in Pakistan. Such a comforting and homely experience in the heart of Bucharest. Highly recommended for anyone missing desi food! 🇵🇰❤️

I entered the restaurant as I had some spare time and I wanted to eat something. From my experience, almost every time I tried eating from a small business, I was impressed by the quality of the food compared to the popularity of the place. Just like it happened now. I noticed there was nobody inside and the amount of reviews was limited, but they were really good so I entered. The man at the counter was helpful, accommodating and very patient, as I was pretty undecided and it took me a little longer to make up my mind. Seating is very limited, but you can still enjoy your food to go. If you decide to dine in, though, you have two tables available and they are comfortable and clean. I gave it 4 stars for atmosphere as it was a bit too cold inside for my liking, but the experience was just as enjoyable. There are many options with meat, but also vegetarian. The food is fresh, prepared on the spot and the waiting time is not long (I waited for about 5 minutes). I eventually ordered one chicken samosa, which was crunchy and flavourful, a warm and tasty garlic naan and a portion of chicken do pyaza, also extremely good and it came with plain rice. They are very attentive to ask and adjust the level of spiciness based on your personal tolerance or preference before they prepare your food. I m really glad I decided to try their Indian food and order something less popular than butter chicken, which you can find almost anywhere (I am convinced their butter chicken is great too, though).
Thank you for the amazing culinary experience and keep up the good work! :)

Wonderful Thai food truck run by a friendly couple. The wife is Thai so you get great authenticity.

The meat & basil was excellent, as was the sweet & sour and the curry.

The whole area is really cool with outdoor seating, artificial beach and food trucks.  Pity there was no live music, that would have been even better

We had Tom Yum at Electric Castle. Guys, if you call this Tom Yum - sorry, but you’ve clearly never had the real thing. It was just some hard-boiled chicken in an oversalted broth, nothing like the authentic version.

The owner is Thai and a very nice lady, we were there when they were about to close so they didn’t have much left to order since they are very popular among office people there.

We recommend Tom Yum Kai, this one tastes like authentic Thai foods and Pad sea ew kai. And the foods are reasonable but I suggest to come around 11AM, so have more options to order:)

I ordered stir-fried noodles and spring rolls and holy mother they taste so good, insanely delicious. I also ordered green curry back home as well which not surprisingly, turned out to be well done as well. As a Thai person myself. This place helps me cure my homesickness. ☺️ Another thing that I like about this place is that the price. They are not so expensive compared to other Thai restaurants. Shout out to this local small business made with passion by a Thai woman and her husband! 💖

The best Thai food in town, the price was cheaper than other authentic thai restaurants in here. I have tried the new menu Garlic pepper beef. The taste was so delicious as a thai people I would recommend!!

name: Trickshot
address: Mall Promenada, Calea Floreasca 246B, 014476 București, Romania

reviews.text:
Very good quality and tasty foods.
Friendly service, good enough temperature.
Not so nice decoration
Good atmosphere, overall good food. Would be even better If there were more variety of beer to offer. The waitress, Ruxanda, is very amable!

Reservation is recommended for peak dining hours.
Otherwise counter or round table seats are the only other options.
Food service is quite fast. Tasty though we hope for larger serving size.
A little to the noisy side, thus not a romantic place to dine.
Good for large group of friends, family or colleagues.

We came here after shopping. We had high hopes but it was really disappointing.
Service was terrible. We still don't know who our server was. We had like three of them. The first person that took our order apparently skipped putting in my meal.
I did get my appetizer, lahmuajin which was really good. The pasta was nice, The fish and chips were mediocre. Muscles were extremely dry since the bowl was too deep and only the bottom were in the sauce.
Highly recommend. All staffs are very accommodating specially chandra

name: Vivo - Fusion Food Bar Floreasca
address: Bucharest One, Calea Floreasca NR.246 Parter, SECTOR 2, 077190 București, Romania

reviews.text: The food is really good. I like the Italian burger it has red sauce on the top of the burger, and it makes it taste like Italian l. I would recommend this. The service is good. The waiters are fast, and the food came very fast. The atmosphere was chill inside it reminds me of a coffee place.

Overall, Vivo Burger delivers a fantastic burger experience that stands out in both flavor and quality. The staff was friendly and efficient, ensuring our orders were prepared quickly and accurately. The portion sizes were generous, and the prices were reasonable for the quality offered. Whether you’re a burger enthusiast or just looking for a satisfying meal, Vivo Burger is definitely worth a visit.”

Truly nice experience with this burger restaurant !

Service is blazing fast and super polite, one of the best I have experienced in Bucharest.

The atmosphere of the interior is cosy and well designed but the music, for my taste, is not appropriate not to mention that is a bit on the loud side.

Most importantly, the food/burgers are ok, neither excellent nor too bad. For the price offered, I was expecting something more fancy in both looks and taste.

One of the best burger places in Bucharest! They serve the best spicy chicken burger and their beef burgers are also to die for!

Highly recommended!!

Update: we recently had lunch here and the beef burger was so salty. I didn’t finish my burger as it wasn’t very edible due to saltiness.
Really nice airport bar and restaurant. Surprisingly good burger! Really liked the beer selection also. Happy place to kill an hour or two while I waited for my flight.

Best kebap around! And if you take the prices into account, I'd say it truly is worth 5 stars. They make their own pita, use a very interesting combination of spices, and the meat is so good. The manager is very kind, always treats clients with a smile on his face. And look, they offer free wet wipes AND individually packed gums. That's very cool!

Would’t recommend eating there. The place is not welcoming at all. Not many food options, the quality does not seem so good, the place is not tidy.
Furthermore, it is even expensive, and finally the owner of the place tried to fool me into paying almost double but I paid attention to the amount on the POS and I waited a lot until he changed it.

Very good Adana kebab I loved the food. Its a small shop with not manny choifes but the main kebab is very good there could small adjustments made to the salad to be over the top just as the meat itself but its not pricey i think

Looks like an original Turkish kebab
The friendly staff seem to be OGs
The food is also original, takes more to prepare than other places because they make it on the spot.

You can have here delicious and well done turkish meals!
Although it's a small local, you can stay and eat outside the store where there is a place with tables and chairs protected from the bad weather if the case.

There are always lots o people here standing in line for a delicious cream soup, Sis kebap or salad!

The owner is really pleasant and hardworking and friendly like all the staff!

Average value mall.
Clean, many well known mid level, medium & low price brands.
Very Good café & restaurants

I really liked this mall. It’s very cozy, calm, and clean. We bought everything we wanted. I liked Zara here more than in Grand Mall in Bucharest. Massimo Dutti is very good. There is Coccinelle and Furla. There are various boutiques that are truly enjoyable.
Well organized mall with a lot of shops. I like the open space of food court in the last floor

A very decent place with lots of fashion brands, everything is clean and comfortable.
It'not big, but is worth visiting. You will do a great shopping without getting tired here.
I liked its lockers, as one can leave his or her belongings there and continue shopping

Very nice mall to visit. Next to metro. Variety of shops to buy clothes, shoes, electronics and snacks, candies food. There is a nice bistrot on the top floor that you can have your coffee and eat too. You can find exchange spot inside the mall in can you need cash in local currency. Also is located next to skyscraper, which is a restaurant that worths to visit. ( reservation required ).

The location is nice, but the service was disappointing. Its very slow. We came as a team, with pre-ordered foods, but they were delivered after 2.5hrs, and not hot! Unfortunately, we did not enjoy eating because of long waiting time. I hope they will improve.

Everything was amazing - the chocolate mousse was delightful, the sashimi and hummus appetizers were two of my favorites of the night, the Captain Bumbu drink was sweet and delicious, and the hoisin duck was sooo good!! Would highly recommend.

We recently celebrated our daughter’s baptism at Medusa Restaurant, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. Everything was perfect from start to finish! The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and enjoyed by all our guests. The cocktails were outstanding, creative, and full of flavor – a highlight of the evening for many of us.
The staff (students) were incredibly friendly, attentive, and helpful, making sure that everyone felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout the entire event. Their kindness and professionalism added so much to the warm atmosphere.
A special mention goes to Roxana, the manager – she is absolutely amazing! Kind, easy-going, funny, and always willing to help, she made the entire process stress-free and enjoyable. Her dedication, positive energy, and great sense of humor created such a welcoming environment, and we couldn’t have asked for a better person to support us on this special day.
We wholeheartedly recommend Medusa Restaurant to anyone looking for a place with fantastic food, wonderful drinks, and a team that goes above and beyond to make your event truly special. Thank you, Roxana, and the entire Medusa team, for giving us such beautiful memories!
The service was amazing, staff are friendly and helpful. The food was delicious. We came on Greek night and the dancing was fun

We booked a VIP table for their New Year’s Eve party. Effort: 4/5. Execution: 2/5.

The night started badly with SMS notifications about our reservation being cancelled, even though we had paid. This happened twice (once before arrival, once at the door), and although it was eventually sorted out, it set a bad tone for the evening.

The venue itself is nice, our table placement was excellent, and the food selection and quality were good. Unfortunately, that’s where the positives mostly end.

After a strong start with live music, a DJ took over and completely killed the atmosphere for over two hours. The dance floor emptied, guests repeatedly asked for music changes, and even the manager’s intervention didn’t help. Paying a premium price to listen to music that clearly wasn’t working for the crowd was very disappointing.

The biggest issue, however, was the table service. The waitress disappeared for long periods despite table service being included. When she returned, she repeatedly tried to scam us.

When we asked for a bottle of a drink that was already included by the glass in our package, she told us we had to pay extra for it. This turned out to be false after we checked with the manager.

Later, when a second DJ came on (unfortunately with the same crap music), she offered to “talk to the DJ” and change the music for 250 RON (~50 EUR). One of my foreign friends paid this amount me not knowing of it. She went up to the DJ, whispered something, and nothing changed. When asked about the money, she avoided answering.

Toward the end of the night, she offered our group coffee for 150 RON (30 EUR) for three coffees, despite coffee being included in our package and costing a fraction of that in Bucharest. When confronted, she backed off and brought the coffees “for free.”

This was particularly disappointing because:
- My foreign friends left with a very poor impression about locals, feeling they were being repeatedly targeted for scams.
- There was also a Romanian guest at our table, making these attempts even more unnecessary to try.
- Had the service been attentive and honest—clearing plates, managing glasses, and actually providing service—we would have gladly left a generous tip. Instead, we left frustrated and disappointed, without tipping at all.

Disappointing experience overall.

They constantly asked for more money: for music, for drinks, even for the wardrobe.All the night, many people repeatedly asked them to change the music and play something appropriate for a party, something you could actually dance to. Unfortunately, the DJs they brought were a complete scam. They even had two DJs, which makes it hard to understand where they found them, but instead of improving the night, they completely ruined it and still asked for extra money.
