They were accomodating to all our requests and polite. I will be returning to Romania soon and I will be eating here again. I would recommend Allegro highly to anybody that would like quality food at a decent and affordable price. I would've paid a lot more for the food. Thanks.

I've only been here once but I was positively impressed. The terrace is spacious and nicely put together with potted plants and the tables fit around 6 persons so it's good for bigger groups. There were pillows on the benches for a more comfortable sitting which is rare for most of the other restaurants. Everything was clean. The waiter was friendly (he wore a mask also) and answered all our questions. We ordered the special of the day so the food came fast and it was very good. The dessert was also good and nicely plated. As the prices go it wasn't that expensive. In my opinion it was quite fair related to the quality of the food. The only downside is that both us and them forgot about the take out we ordered but it's not that much of a big deal anyways.

edit: i've been there many times and the first impression holds strong.
Great food, great service, very good prices, really enjoyed the place!
Nice and friendly service. Got a really good savarina for 10 Lei, it was carefully wrapped and I ate it in a nearby Cafe because they don't have seating.
This shop is in a good neighbourhood. It is on the main road. It is only a takeaway because there is no seating. All the cakes are delicious, and you can order a cake for that special day.
High variety of cakes and sweets, if you crave something sweet this is the place to go! Also the personal is very polite😊
Tasty. Good.
You can't find better cakes in the neighbourhood. Highly recommended as the products are very good. Around 5lei/dessert.
The pancakes have nice smell, the flavour it's incredible
super
I had a pancake with delicious vanilla cream and blueberry jam. The pancake was very well made, soft and tasty. I highly recommend it!
I usually get coffee from them, they have the best Latte Coffee in the entire Mall and at a very good price. I also got pancakes a few times, they tasted good and natural.
The best pancakes ever, fluffy, with everything your heart desires, impeccable service, unbeatable prices... and large portions. I recommend

There was an event downstairs when we arrived and serving the plates was very difficult. But the meat one was good, but the vegetarian one didn't look so good. the waiters came less often. I sat outside on the small terrace.
The interior wooden stairs are not safe, the wooden floor as well. I am amazed that they did not receive a fee, authorities to force them to renovate. Poor quality pizza, the hot sauce was horrible.
Papanas and beer best combo. Also nice place to hang with your firends.

Good food. One of the best papanași that I ate in Bucharest. The attention of the personal is not to good regarding clients demands, but they are trying. Good prices. Tasty food for meat lovers. I've tried better cocktails in other places. Not bad for a quartier restaurant. Nice rooftop.

Good place to stop for a drink and some food. They have a large food menu and a lot of wines and beers.
The prices are OK for Bucharest and that area. They have a lot of craft local beers and many assortments of wines.
The place is clean and huge, the toilets sparkle and the staff is friendly, quick and the food tasty and yummy.
This is also a good place to bring your kids because the staff is really sweet and there's a lot of space for the kids to run around.
Overall, this is a very nice place where you can bring your family and enjoy a nice dinner or hang around, drinking some beers and eating some bar food with friends.

name: Erra Restaurant
address: Strada Constantin C. Nottara 13, 031461 București, Romania

reviews.text: What a treat! From the moment you step through the door, you’re home. The staff is kind and welcoming, the food is delicious, and the prices are very affordable. The chef is super personable and will visit your table to talk about wine pairings and his treatment of the menu. It’s farm-to-table and it’s exceptional.

Erra in Bucharest is an upscale take on traditional Romanian food that actually hits the mark. I went for an early fall dinner — ambient yellow lighting, people chatting, laughing, hanging out at their local spot. The music kept the energy up without killing conversation.

I had pork with cabbage and potatoes — pork slightly crispy, full of flavor, solid portions. Paired it with a German beer they suggested, and ended with a traditional liquor digestive. Presentation matched the vibe: high-end but hearty.

Staff were attentive — not over-friendly like the U.S., but they came when waved down. One hiccup: their card reader was broken that day, so cash only. Make sure you’re ready.

Overall? Flavors are real, portions generous, drinks solid, atmosphere inviting. Perfect spot to linger with friends or family. I left full, happy, and already planning my next visit.

The chef was incredibly friendly and helpful, creating a very welcoming atmosphere. The food was outstanding - beautifully presented and full of flavor. We had the braised beef, duck liver, and pumpkin cheesecake - everything was absolutely delicious! Highly recommend this place for anyone who loves great food and warm hospitality.

I've been visiting this wonderful restaurant for several weeks now, and with each visit, I find myself falling more and more in love with the place. It has truly become my favorite spot, a place where I feel completely at home..
The first thing that strikes you is the atmosphere. It's incredibly cozy and beautiful, an oasis of calm and good taste. The interior design is simply captivating. You can tell that a lot of thought and passion went into every single detail. From the lighting to the decor, everything feels intentional and contributes to a unique, charming ambiance. It's the kind of place where you want to linger, enjoying the surroundings as much as the meal itself.
And then there's the service. It's absolutely top-notch. The team here is made up of people who genuinely love their jobs and are passionate about what they do. They are attentive, knowledgeable, and always have a genuine smile. Their dedication truly shines through, making every guest feel valued and well-cared for. It's rare to find such a high level of service, and it makes all the difference.
Of course, a restaurant is nothing without its food, and the food here is simply unbelievable. Every single dish is a work of art, a masterpiece of flavor and presentation. The quality of the ingredients and the skill of the chefs are evident in every bite. I've tried many dishes from the menu, and each one has been a delightful surprise, exceeding my expectations.
Let's start with the pork salad. The meat was incredibly tender and melted in my mouth, and the fresh, vibrant vegetables were perfectly complemented by a rich and delicious sauce. Next, I tried the shrimp pasta. The pasta was delicate and succulent, and I was captivated by a surprisingly wonderful combination: zucchini. It was a brilliant touch that I'll definitely be recreating in my own kitchen. The other pasta I tried was incredible; the tomato sauce, with its delicious mushrooms, completely blew my taste buds away. The pizza we ordered was also delicious, with a perfect crust and an excellent sauce.
But the true star of this place was the steak(Entrecôte). It absolutely stole my heart. Without a doubt, this is the most exquisite meat I have ever tasted in a restaurant. It was incredibly tender, juicy, and perfectly cooked. It's a true culinary masterpiece. The steak was served with the most delicious truffle potatoes in the world—crispy on the outside and wonderfully soft on the inside. I could eat them as a standalone dish! The steak was also accompanied by a fantastic salad and a perfect pesto sauce.
I also had the pleasure of trying a combination that I never thought would work: steak and shrimp. The delicate shrimp and savory steak, paired with a fresh salad, created a harmonious and wonderful dish. The bruschetta was another highlight. The juicy, flavorful salsa combined with the wonderful prosciutto, and a hint of pesto created a symphony of flavors.
Initially, I thought the steak would be my favorite, but then I discovered the burgers. This is, officially, the best burger I have ever eaten. The perfectly toasted bun, the incredibly juicy patty, fresh vegetables, and sauce created a masterful balance of flavors. Like the steak, the burger was served with those amazing truffle potatoes and a crisp, fresh salad.
You absolutely must try the brownie for dessert. It has a perfect balance of flavor, without being overly sweet. The ice cream had notes of mint, which blended beautifully with a berry confit that took me back to my childhood, when I first tasted fresh wild berries.
Another thing worth noting is the generous portions. You get an incredible feeling and leave completely satisfied. This is a place that delivers maximum gastronomic pleasure with every single bite.
This place isn't just a restaurant; it's an experience. If you're looking for delicious food, a beautiful setting, and impeccable service from people who truly care, I couldn't recommend it more highly.

Not only is this place constantly empty,  which says everything about how people feel about it, but the attitude of the staff is absolutely gross. The arrogance is unreal, and the way they treat customers feels outright discriminatory. It’s beyond uncomfortable. I’ve contacted ANAF because something seriously isn’t right. They don’t even have a proper POS system, and the whole operation feels shady and potentially illegal. I’ve tried to pay by card multiple times, and every single time the excuse is the same: “We have problems with the POS. If you have euros or dollars, anything.” How does that not sound suspicious? It sounds dirty, unprofessional, and completely untrustworthy. However I just received confirmation the authorities will impose the necessary fines.
The place has this grim, unpleasant atmosphere, cold, hostile, and frankly disgusting. The staff is rude, dismissive, and disrespectful to a shocking degree. There’s no warmth, no professionalism, no basic decency.
Honestly, it’s no surprise the place is always empty, it feels as lifeless as a cemetery.

Quiet place with good food and nice people! The staff was very friendly and the food was really tasty. My wife and i were full and decided to share their tiramisu which is homemade and looked so good that i forgot to take a picture and just enjoyed it ! Good place to spend a nice Sunday afternoon!

Still the best Italian food in the city, after more than 10 year being their client, great tastes, rich recipes, lovely atmosphere, personel going the extra-mile.  @the manager, please check the pipes, there was a funny smell :)

Lovely and cozy Italian restaurant. The pizza was better than average, but it didn't match my expectations for a Napolitaen pizza. However, the mussels with red sauce were really spectacular and  mouth-watering. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and I recommend this place!

The restaurant is located 3 km from the old town, so we took a cab to get there. We were welcomed by friendly staff, who spoke excellent English, and translated the menu to us. The restaurant is very nicely decorated and I found the intact tree in the center very beautiful.
The food was sadly not as good as we’d expected it to be. The pizzas lacked tomato sauce, the four cheese pizza was quite tasteless and the house wine was quite bland and disappointing. The pizza with Salami tasted better.
Not an authentic Italian experience but better than most places in Bucharest.
Great Italian food restaurant.  We had different main dishes, appetizers, and pizza.  They were all really well made and flavorful.  Service was welcoming, friendly, and fast.

Pretty place, but more important, delicious place! We tried 3 courses and absolutely loved the chocolate-coated wheat dessert, mixed with lovage ice-cream. Such a twist for a traditional dessert! 💚🤎 Dan and Denisa took really good care of us, made us feel at home. Will definitely return. Thank you and best of luck! 👏🫶

The staff were very welcoming and attentive! The presentation of the dishes was excellent, with beautiful tableware and wonderfully prepared food. We had a great time and would love to come back. We also truly appreciated the complimentary drink — a lovely touch!
Highly recommended!

Our experience at Strabun was great, the food was delicious with generous portions and cool atmosphere. We had both meat and the vegan cauliflower dish and everyone was impressed with their choice.

The service was fast and when there was a mixup with our orders (two orders came with the wrong toppings), the staff was quick to fix it and the extra toppings were left to share free of charge.

Strongly recommend if you want to taste a smart and modern interpretation of Romanian cuisine. The coliva dessert with ice-cream was stunning and surprising.

We got the pork and the beef, and both were just amazing. The meats were tender, and full of flavor. Both mash potatoes melted in our months. The contrast with the cold beets was refreshing for the mouth.
Definitely a place to stop by.

My only suggestion is that the restaurant would feel more cozy if the lights were dimmer.

I rarely give 5 stars across everything such as food, service and atmosphere but this restaurant has it all. Reinterpretation of romanian food but with style and a very great taste. I returned during the same week to taste something different and I was impressed both times. The service is impeccable and the food is amazing. I will definitely come again and it is a must go and eat for Bucharest.

name: Gold Baklava
address: Bloc M36, Strada Nerva Traian 14, 031046 București, Romania

reviews.text: very good baklava, tastes like heaven. reasonable prices and the lady that sells it is super kind
I guess it's OK. Don't expect to be blown away.
Genuine Turkish products, nice people
Excelent! 10+
Good baklava.

I got the crispy menu + pancake with nutella.
The fries were good, different from most fries but I can't say they were extraordinary, just different

That was the only good thing
The chicken (at least the one I got) has a horrible smell and taste
The pancake IS NOT WITH NUTELLA it's just a cheap chocolate sauce, it's not even finetti.
I got the wrong juice and sauce, I was supposed to get regular cola and ketchup, I got garlic and cola zero.

Overall, I hope Glovo gives me my money back at least on the menu after this horrible experience and the hour and a quarter wait for delivery, the fries are not bad but everything else is horrible and after some false marketing (where's my nutella again?)
Quality food, cooked with soul. I really recommend it.
Tasty and fresh food! I highly recommend it!
I highly recommend it! The food is very tasty, the portions are generous, the prices are good, and the staff is very friendly.

Expensive food and very small portions! The leaflets they left said they were not valid and that there were no offers from there. I recommend Socul! There you will find good quality, quantity and price.

What a breath of fresh air! We were ecstatic when we got the soup. The lamb tenderloins are amazing as well. Highly recommend this spot. We spent around 400 lei total but they have cheaper options as well. The menu is diverse. It was also nice that they offer both Romanian and English versions of the menu.

I ❤️ restaurants that exceed expectations
Almost didn’t want to go in cos it wasn’t as pretty as we wanted it to be from the outside.
But we were so glad that we did.
The oxtail soup, grilled pork neck, pffer steak with tdf potatoes, everything was super tasty and the portions were generous.
Packed a seafood pasta back home and it was delicious and fresh.
Definitely be back many times over and over 🤭
Superb service & they also had a special wine from the church
Although the atmosphere didn’t really match the concept of the food but I think this cute and unusual combo makes it even more unique

Yesterday my boyfriend and I visited this cozy restaurant. We were very satisfied. We were served by a very kind gentleman, and the food was excellent — we had the pepper steak and a hamburger. The portions were generous and everything was perfectly seasoned. Great value for money! If we visit Bucharest again in the future, we will definitely come back.

Very tasty Romanian traditional food and drinks. Fresh food. Good beer draft or romanian bottles beer.
It may seem expensive but the portions are large.
Very tasty papanasi with blueberries jam!
Very pleasant terrace in the summer, a hidden culinary gem close to the center of Bucharest!
You must try!
We will come back for more!

Very good Romanian 🇷🇴 restaurant with fresh food and good drinks 🍸 🍺 🍷

Location is a hidden, you need to know where to find it.

From Monday - Friday they have a yummy 😋 menu (meat & vegetarian) try it out!

A la carte: all dishes are fresh and good. Loving the burger 🍔 and the chicken schnitzel.

Prices and service are good.

Overall beautiful 🤩 we will be back for sure 🙏

We had the Sicilian shrimps, fried sea bass salad, shrimp and zucchini ravioli and Panna cotta al amaretto. The fried sea bass in the salad wasn't the best, it tasted too fishy and the salad overall wasn't something I would try again. The other dishes were nice. The service was very good considering how crowded it was. The place isn't that cozy and I am not a fan of the atmosphere.

I enjoyed myself so much on the first visit I came back again the next day. But sadly it wasn’t as good.
There are some hits & misses on the menu.
Minestrone soup was decent but the pumpkin soup was a joke. It was very tasty but measly in portion. They returned with another proper serving but it was clearly diluted with water. But at least the waiter tried…
Vitello tonnato was delicious, one of the better ones I’ve had.
Caprese salad was average.
Artichoke risotto was pretty interesting
Seafood pasta was lacklustre, I expected better.
New York Strip was well grilled 7.9/10
Soggy fried with garlic was somewhat yummy
Fresh spinach pasta in ragu was enjoyable
I wished I didn’t order the recommended panna cotta, it was too heavy n stodgy :/
Big minus- there was no paper n both toilet doors couldn’t be locked.
For this price point, it’s not really acceptable

i would recommend you all this restaurant! there is great music, the food is delicious and the portions are perfect. they are fast here so you don’t have to wait for to long to get your food and drinks. the romania rose is also very good, even my boyfriend drinks it even he doesn’t likes wine at all!! best restaurant in the neighborhood!

We've been here for a couple of times.

The restaurant is placed inside of the mall. It is very modern and cool looking.

This is an Italian restaurant with many dishes (like the carbonara pasta) following a traditional recipe.

We enjoy coming here, we try different dishes each time and some of them are amazing but others are bland. However, all of the food is fresh and they use high quality ingredients. They make their own pasta that can also be bought. 🍝

The service is always great, no need to make a reservation most of the times, the restaurant is huge and has inside and outside tables.

Great place to meet with friends and to eat great pasta. The restaurant is lovely and a great surprise for pasta lovers. Easy to reach at the Mall Vitan. We tried some ravioli, pasta and beef steak. Everything was very good and beautifully arranged on plates. The cocktails were ok, but can be improved. We will definitely come back for pasta.

A refined spot with a modern atmosphere and a menu that feels both creative and well executed. The dishes are beautifully presented, flavours are balanced, and the overall experience feels polished from start to finish. A great choice for a relaxed meal that still feels a bit special.

What a great find! Sardin is hidden in a quiet neighborhood, but the food and atmosphere make it totally worth the trip. Every dish we tried was delicious - fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served. And it’s not overpriced. The staff were super friendly and made us feel welcome right away. The place has a very nice and cozy setting with modern and unique decor. Such a nice surprise for this part of town - can’t wait to go back!

Good food (tried the antipasti platter & some pasta). Great atmosphere & attentive service. Fair prices (except the desserts, those feel quite expensive, even though I haven't tried one). Large collection of wines.

Had high hopes as a friend recommended this place. Inviting decor, loved the blue.
Too bad that my seafood is too salty 😪 n the pasta was mediocre.
It’s on the expensive side, n you definitely have higher expectations for it too.
The wine menu is kinda duh… 🙄 meant for deliberate spendings.
Food was very good, the service was impecable. Waiting times are very low. It is just a good place to eat Italian dishes.

Tasty food! I had a lasagna and it was exactly as I expected. From my experience, when it takes 40-50 minutes for your food to be served, for sure it's not a frozen casserole. Excellent atmosphere and a nice cozy space for us to spend it with our friends

Nice and cozy restaurant with friendly staff. The bathroom was very clean and the food was served pretty fast. The grilled chicken breast was juicy and well seasoned, same for the oven potatoes. Also, the asian beef was very good and the dark beer was awesome. They have different offers if you eat at the location on Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday or for groups on the week-end.

I'm a very complicated customer, some would even say I'm a Karen :)) but this place delivers more than expected. Great beef soup. Great chicken snitzel and great padron peppers. Also the sauce that comes with the chicken snitzel needs to be mentioned as tasting great. The prices are a bit high but okay compared to the rest of the city. Everywhere is way too expensive for the local economy. I recommend the place though as a returning customer.

Great atmosphere, awesome staff and great food.
Was my first time here, but definitely I will come back. Seems that I am not the only returning customer since everyone seems to know and like Isa 🤩.
All staff seems to be nice, but I am pretty sure she set some high standards for her colleagues since even the people on the table next to me are asking for her.
Seems too big of a coincidence if you ask me 😁. Looks like everyone knows her. Keep it up!
Prices are also decent, btw.

Very good food. Big portions and very tasteful.
This is the first time when we came and we will definitely return or order online. :)
Nice service, didn’t wait too much for the order and the prices are good for the quality of the food/services.
Recommand this place!

name: Ristorante DaGiulio
address: Strada Popa Stoica Farcaș, 031454 București, Romania

reviews.text:
Pros
•	Authentic Italian cuisine that’s truly delightful
•	Generous portions that leave you satisfied
•	Friendly and welcoming staff
•	Wide variety of dishes to suit every taste
•	Excellent value for money

Cons
•	Honestly, none that come to mind!

Conclusion
If you’re in Bucharest and craving a taste of Italy, this is the place to visit. The food is exceptional, bursting with authentic Italian flavors, and the cozy, inviting atmosphere makes it a perfect dining spot. It quickly became my favorite Italian restaurant, and I can’t recommend it enough!

The food here is fantastic—I had the carbonara pasta, and it was absolutely delicious. The atmosphere is wonderful as well, we attended an Italian live music night, which made the experience even more special. The musicians are incredibly talented, and there’s something about this place that gives it a unique charm, making me want to come back in the future. I highly recommend it if you’re looking for a complete and memorable experience.

our waiter was very nervous because I ordered appetizers+ main course and my friends just main course.
the risotto had a neutral taste, nothing to do with this dish. Also it was very oily.  I had to put a whole bowl of Parmesan for some taste.

For someone who has never tasted Italian food or risotto, in this case, it can be considered an average or good restaurant. Else, forget about it.
Food quality and service changed a lot since the restaurant first opened.

Went there and has some ciorba and some bolognese pasta. I would recommend the bread and the sour cream that came for the ciorba. Both the ciorba and the pasta was watery and I had to order extra parmesan for pasta. That is the most unitalian thing I've ever heard of.

Tasty pasta, good wine. They have a lot of options, and it is hard to decide. I tried some fresh tagliattelle with zucchini, pancetta (so tasty!) and piselli (peas).

Also had a taste of funghi porcini e Salssicia, very tasty as well.

Definitely coming back for more 👌
one of the best and softest meat i tried, ( bastrama dish)

Family style restaurant. You will know everyone at the end of your dinner, starting with the owner. Great live music (Macedonian, Romanian and Greek folk), Authentic grill and various local vinery choices.

It's quiet and very spacious. The food is typical Romanian, but they also have specialties that are better than the normal stuff. I'm a fan of the chicken Gyros in particular. It's not fancy dining or anything, just very solid-always-the-same decent food. Beer is also a good price.

This is the sort of place that easily becomes your local if you live in the area. The owner is  always there and chats with everyone, the waiters come to know you. It's kid friendly too.
Great place 4 a night out. The food is delicious and not too expensive.
The food was not as good as i knew it from the past, otherwise nice place and atmosphere, ok service
Very good cocktails, milkshakes and frappes,  food is very tasty (tried many things from the menu - always perfectly done) service is good, major points for all day breakfast menu.
Don't offend the waitress by ordering one coffee and one lemonade. She'll roll her eyes and will not respond to "Thank you" or salute when you leave.
Great atmosphere great food very friendly what's not to like reccomend

Just a coffee place, nothing fancy. They serve some food and snacks.
On the bad side, even if you don't smoke there's no escaping the smell. To gain acces to the non smoking area you have to pass the smoking lounge which is poorly ventilated.
On the good side, they seem implicated and careful with the clients.
Best cappuccino in the area. Good Aperol. Nice food. Smoking on the closed terrace disturbes.

To me it's by far the best restaurant for Romanian, traditional and alacarte dishes in the whole of Bucharest. Nice organic classical foods, even fried octopus sometimes, beef liver, tripe soup, and many more. Typical "cârciumă bună" style place. Think of the former Pui de Urs / Shorley restaurants in Regie, but this time with both class and style. I was always made to feel welcomed here.. although I didn't eat that often in this place, I always was well received and remembered by the staff. Food is of great quality also - in Bucharest almost all food in commerce including in restaurants (except of 5 star hotels) is absolutely terrible and sometimes damaging; - not here. Everything is tasty here. Big advantage. They also have a smoking terrace if some in your group are smoking.. And overall a place to have lunch, dinner or have a date or event for mid size budget.

I also recommend the unfiltered alcohol free bear here - very good, if but a bit expensive naturally.

Salt & Pepper is a decent Italian restaurant. The main thing, the food, is done right. Good quality pasta, flavourful sauces, nice deserts. Where Salt & Pepper falls a bit short is the staff - polite, but not the least bit enthusiastic, with shortcomings when it comes to anything else besides the basics (not paying attention to customers even when not that busy, not knowing what "gluten free" is) - and the atmosphere, since patrons can smoke on the (very much enclosed) terrace. So, come strictly for the food and you'll have a nice experience.
Been here 3 times already. The food was really good. On Women's day they gave us flowers and free champagne. Nice gesture. It made us feel special.
A decent Italian restaurant where the service and hygiene are ok, the desserts very delicious. It has a good location and you can park near the sidewalk.
Excepțional.  Big portions and very good and tasty food. Beef is excellent! Slow cooked and delicious.  In my photo, it is half of the portion. It definitely is for 2 people

name: Din Fu
address: Str. Alexandru Moruzzi Voievod nr. 78, 031155 București, Romania

reviews.text: The food is so good here, no wonder they have been open for more than 20 years. The pork knuckle with soy sauce is to die for but don’t skip the other options on the menu. Also, keep in mind that the portions are huge.

Pleasantly surprised to find Chong Qing Grilled Fish here :D delicious but the fish got a crazy lot of bones
Generous portions here, most people had to takeaway. Awesome cos Nobody should waste yummy food. I think it will take me 2 days to finish what I ordered here 😂

Authentic experience, delicious food, great quality price ratio. Staff was very friendly and we did not have to wait long for our dishes, even though it was rather crowded when we dined there. Highly recommend their popular dish of fried green beans, that was the highlight of our meal!

Food tastes amazing!
You have to try the Gan Bian fried beans.
Prices are good considering the big portions.
I gave 4 stars because we waited 26 minutes for our order to be taken (I do not recommend going on weekend evenings) but like I said the food is great.

It’s quite hard to get a table at this restaurant even though it’s a neighborhood one. However, the food is delicious and I’ve had one of the best Chinese chicken dish called “Chicken with fish flavour”. Sounds funny, but trust me it’s one of the best thing ever.

name: Efes Restaurant
address: Bloc M70, Strada Nerva Traian 17-19, 031043 București, Romania

reviews.text:
First time here, we tried a bit of everything. The cold meze is decent but nothing out of the ordinary, the hot sesame bread is the best part.
Out of all the dishes we got, the Adana Kebab was by far the most disappointing. The meat itself is tender and juicy but not very flavorful and it comes with plain rice and a cabbage salad that doesn’t really pair well with the rest.
The other dishes were much better.
Our waiter was polite and helpful. The place itself is not very traditional looking despite a few decorations on the walls and the electronic music was very unfitting.
All in all, a good meal but many things can be improved.

The first time I've been here i was amazed of the hospitality of this restaurant. I'm a regular, so I can confidently say that this place is always welcoming and the food is surprisingly delicious. The quality of the food is consistent, as it never fails to amaze me. Our usual waiter, Costi, is one of the best waiters I've had the pleasure of meeting. He's always friendly, and he takes his job seriously, and never fails to make you feel welcome.

Been here on a Saturday at lunch time, expected the place to be full, and it wasn’t. It was my second time at Efes, first time I was impressed and that’s why I wanted so bad to get back and I was happy that it was not crowded, only to leave completely disappointed.

The food is good, but the portions got smaller with the price getting higher since my previous visit (January 2024).

However, what bothered me the most was the service. There is was one sweet lady that I thought was gonna serve us (she did the previous time) and a guy that honestly… he stood by our table like we were preparing to leave without paying. He brought us the menus and literally 2 mins after, asked if we’re ready, then he came back after 2 minutes again to ask if “we need more time”. He was doing “surveillance” as mentioned, like he thought we were about to leave just like that.
When we asked for the check and told him to not include the tip on the check, he was visibly shocked, but I’m not sure how someone can expect tipping for doing such a bad job.

Nice place for trying out authentic Turkish cuisine. The Adana Kebab is excellent 👌! Good service and reasonable midrange prices. No alcoholic beverages, but they have a good selection of Turkish coffees, freshly squeezed fruit juices and sodas to choose from. Complementary Turkish tea and bread. Haven't tried the desserts yet, but they surely live up to the quality of Turkish traditional cuisine.
Have seen many Turkish people eat here, that must be a good sign.
Overall, a great place to eat out in Bucharest. Not that far from the city center, too, a very safe area and we'll connected to the city's public transportation network.

The food was delicious, but what truly stood out to me was the thoughtful touch of offering complimentary tea. It added a unique and welcoming element to the dining experience that I really appreciated.
The place is nice. The food was good and the portions were large. The service could have been better. You also get something on the house at the beginning and dessert at the end.

Mazzaj has been one of my favorite spots for over 3 years, and it just keeps getting better! The food is always super good — the meat is perfectly cooked, and the tabbouleh is fresh and full of flavor. They’ve recently updated their menu, offering plenty of options for every taste.

Mr. Raffi, the amazing manager, genuinely cares about his customers. He’s always open to feedback, adjusts plates to match our needs, and even improves the place based on suggestions. In fact, the small kids’ playground was added after we recommended it — they truly listen to their guests!

It’s a very family-friendly place with fair prices for the quality you get. We went as a family of 6 and spent over 4 hours there, enjoying the beautiful outdoor seating area next to their water fountain in the afternoon. Everything is clean, from the tables to the bathrooms, and the staff are always friendly and skilled.

If you want delicious food, a welcoming atmosphere, and a restaurant that truly values its customers, Mazzaj is the place to go.

It was a bit off from the main road, but it looked lovely inside. Lots of people were smoking shisha. Hop in the shisha. It doesn't pay to stand around too long. If you are up for it, try it. The price is a bit high, but the service is way too fast. I only wish that the dessert, which is Kunafa with Turkish ice cream, had come much later than the main course. Because I was afraid the ice cream would melt while I was eating the main dish, a plate of shawarma.
Nice spot for coffee and drinks, shisha also available. Closed off terrace is major plus

Authentic Lebanese&Sirian restaurant with within top 3 best lebanese food in Bucharest.
I have visited this restaurant many times since his opening few years ago and I never been dissapointed. The food is delicious!

How can such delicious food fit in such a small and warm place?
Best in town, unquestionably the best in town
mediterranean mixt plate, midii, calamar are my favourites.
The pasta is so delicious that I can't resist eating it.

Located in a quiet neighbourhood, by one of the busiest streets,  it has a nice porch in the summer.  In the cold season,  the porch is closed with glass panels making it a nice place.  The menu is mostly Italian,  with something for everyone.  You can get pizza, burgers, Seafood,  and some international dishes.  The music was well chosen for the season,  without being boring.  The food was average,  without anything special or memorable.  The service is average to low.  Long waiting times for having the empty plates taken  away from the table. We had to ask for glasses after we received the bottle of water.  The crowd is mostly locals . In fact,  the 3 tables taken when we visited there, were occupied by locals,  probably living in the neighbourhood.  Medium prices.  A good option to eat,  especially if they will improve their service.

Good:
- good seafood(even though I’m not an enthusiast, just once in a while): pasta -foto1, salads- foto2, large portions, they also have pizza, stakes
- nice service
- small prices (25E for 2 persons)
- not crowded on a Friday evening
- interesting ceiling(go there to see what I m writing about)

Not so good:
- on the terrace is a pest repellent which makes a subtle noise
- a few flies

I phone at 21:28 to order just to be told that they already closed. After pointing out the closing time, I was asked if I wanna and collect it and upon confirm I would, I was told they already shut down the oven. The reviews seem good, but this episode really left a bad feeling.

Nice restaurant placed in an old building.

It's a combination of sea food and Italian style food.

The view from the terrace is towards the street which is not that bad.

They've advertised a lot that they have fresh mussels so we gave it a go 😊. They were very tasty with a white wine and garlic.

Also the viel ribs was ok (the wedges are with parmezan and comes with a horseradish sauce.

Asesoneated with a glas of rose wine, this was great.

As for the sweets, the Apple pie with ice cream is very god. You can also try the cheese pie with a bechamel sauce.

The service was good and the waiter was asking if everything was alright.

We will definitely try it again and go for some Italian dishes.
The place looks great! Table service was spot on, the food was only good, not great. Anyway, a great place to spend an evening!

Half of the dishes on the menu were not available. Friendly staff but old furniture (the tablecloth was dirty and burned). We ordered pasta and was fine, decent prices to. A plus for this restaurant is the terrace but beware of mosquitoes. We were unable to pay by card so be aware of this.
Great service, beautiful decor and the 1kg Burger is amazing

The restaurant is located in an old, spatious house, our 2 year old daughter was happy to run around (it helped that we were the only clients). The food is good, not great but tasty and it comes in big portions. The service is quick and friendly. All in all, it was a good outing.

I don't like this place. It is upscale and highly rated, but it doesn't live up to its reputation. Bad location, it looks bad on the outside. The live singers sing well but they look like someone's grandmother

A good place to get a pizza so quick. However, I didn't like it so much. The delivery man either was not that polite. Delivery takes like roughly 50 minutes. I was told on the phone we can split the bill, the delivery man said the opposite, so we got somehow in trouble. I don't know, I just don't feel like getting pizza one more here. Not my taste. Not even the pasta.

Ordered a big carnivore pizza, it was tasty but the ingredients were probably expired (or the dough) because it's 3 days later and my stomach is a mess. I do not recommned. Better do it yourself, knowing it's fresh ans you won't get food poisoning. Terrible experience.
i’ve never eaten here. i’ve actually never stepped foot into romania, but my friend greta LOVES this place! after seeing a criminally great review, i hope to stop by one day!

A very good place to eat if you need something quick and tasteful. If you are close to one of their restaurants ( 1 - 2 km ) you can even receive your food in like ~ 20 mins ( if your order is not that big ). Overall the food is great and the serivce too, and I never had a problem with them.

Best pizza I've never had, but it's now on my bucket list.
Seems revenge is a dish best served hot after all, go figure

We had the baptism of our daughter last Sunday, and everything was perfect. Staff guided us from the very beginning, and they did a great job, making the first party of our little one a memorable event for everyone. It has a big parking space, a nice garden, a cozy atmosphere, and good food. I will gladly recommend this location every time I get the chance.
Great service and food. Perfect location. We all had a great time during our event.
Very good hospitality, 5 stars 🌟 for cleanliness and comfort. We really enjoyed staying here, thank you and see you next time 🤗😊
I’ve travelled to many countries and places - this place takes the medal
very good. loved the way they comunicated and the offer.  let the party begin!

Great food.
It will be great if with time you will have more type of Ramèn's.
ordered food, it was amazing. The quality was great and really tasty !
Amazing food and nice staff
Best sushi in town!

We were looking for sushi in the area and we're really lucky to discover this place. While waiting for out order we got some bites to go and they were absolutely delicious, and we're not afraid to order more for our take away experience. The rice was perfectly made, the fish is good, service is excelent, it is exactly what I want from my sushi experience. There are not tables indoor bit otf the weather is nice you can sit outside and enjoy a delicious treat for yourself. We also ordered ramen and my girlfriend really enjoyed it.

name: Amici Da' Piccoli Pieptanari by Chef Tuna Tudor Florin

reviews.text:
This is a jewel of a little pizza shop. Absolutely amazing pizzas for a decent prize. We tried the Diavola and the tuna pizza. Both delicious, we will return for sure! Also, we got our food in a matter of minutes.
The staff was very friendly and helpful. The ambiance is quite intimate and pleasant, the music background was also fitting.
I just love to find such amazing places where you have the owner sitting around and doing his/her best to offer a unique experience. It felt like I was home.
If you're around, don't miss it.

The best pizza I've had this year. Friendly staff, great service, really good prices. Definitely we'll make a weekly habit on visiting this place.
100% recommend
The 5 stars reviews on this place are legit. Finally I found again a good quality pizza with friendly service.
Best pizza in town
A really good pizza.

We got the chicken schnitzel, the paccheri pasta, tiramisu and cannoli. Everything was delicious, the schnitzel was crispy on the outside, and the guanciale was also crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
The tiramisu was amazing.
The service was polite and friendly.
I want to try all of the pasta!!

Everything we ordered at Dieci il Numero was absolutely delicious! The mushroom risotto, carbonara, and cannoli were all incredibly flavorful and perfectly prepared. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into each dish. Definitely one of the best Italian dining experiences I’ve had in Bucharest!

We went for dinner at this Italian restaurant and it was an excellent choice. Everything felt special – the menu, the decorations, the music, and of course the food. Very good prices as well.

We had one of the friendliest waiters we’ve ever met, who really made us feel welcome, and the whole staff seemed cheerful and kind. The food was delicious, and we’ll definitely be coming back to try the pizza and breakfast as well!
Very tasty food: cannoli were amazing, spaghete con gamberi were very tasty, as well as parmigiana di melanzane and olive dorate. Very friendly service. Very tasty tea, good choice of beverages.

We met Daniel, who was a guest at our hotel in Thassos, and later visited Dieci Il Numero in Bucharest. The experience was wonderful with delicious food, a warm atmosphere, and excellent service. Definitely a place we’d recommend to anyone visiting Bucharest! ✨✨

name: Rost Urban Dining
address: Strada Pictor Stefan Dimitrescu 2D, 040765 București, Romania

reviews.text:
The biggest culinary disappointment in Bucharest.

I travel a lot and always try to eat something traditional in restaurants or bars located away from the city center. I look for highly rated places with interesting menus. Rost Urban Dining seemed to be one of those. A 5-star rating on Google, beautiful photos, a good menu. I had to take a 40-minute tram ride from the city center. But it's always worth visiting an interesting place. I'm usually quite lenient and tend to overrate things. Not this time. My first disappointment – right at the entrance, in the glass-enclosed garden, the staff were sitting smoking cigarettes... unacceptable. The stench filled the entire place. I wanted to leave, but my hunger convinced me to stay. We ordered a total of three dishes plus beers. They were a mixed grill for one person, chicken souflage with grilled vegetables, and pasta Milanese. I asked the waiter, dressed more like a customer than a waiter, why I couldn't smell the food. He said the kitchen was on the other side. We received our beer immediately. Tasty and cold. Then came the dishes. My second disappointment – unfortunately, it was below any quality. The grilled mixed dish turned out to be half a pork chop, a chicken breast, a burnt thin sausage cut in half, and a roll of ground meat. Rubbery fries were also served. Everything was cold, looking like something left over from last night's party. I asked the waiter and pointed out that the food was cold. He took it away to heat it up. He returned a few minutes later with a warm dish. The grilled food was dry, not good, and sooty. The fries were disgusting, soft, and soaked in grease. I ate it because I was really hungry. The chicken souflage was warm but bland. The grilled vegetables were a joke – two slices of zucchini, a piece of eggplant, and half of half a bell pepper. Cold and greasy. The pasta was edible – nothing more. My third disappointment – the restaurant's menu was out of date. We left very quickly without leaving a tip – there was no need. I didn't really want to pay for the food either, but I didn't want to cause any trouble. I don't know where these reviews come from. Even the day after visiting this restaurant, we all reek of cigarettes. Owner, think before you answer me – you know I'm right.

Everything was perfect. The staff very friendly, the menu is diverse you have many options and very budget-friendly. The place looks very modern inside and cozy. We received some shots on the house and they had a special menu for halloween so we actually got our food discounted! Also, you can find their menu on the website. Will definitely be back!

The food was traditional and amazing after the owner's suggestion we ordered these amazing plates. The staff was very friendly and the environment chill and cozy. A hidden gem definitely worth visiting!
I come here pretty often. Love this place. Really great value for money. They have also sorts of themed offers - traditional autumn product sale. The server is very friendly, food is always good.
Amazing place, the owners are really great people, it's not overcrowded and the atmosphere is always wonderful, I recommend coming here for a tasty meal or a relaxing night

name: L'incontro Tineretului
address: Tineretului Park, Bulevardul Tineretului 2, Corp C11, 040341 București, Romania

reviews.text: I highly recommend this restaurant. Good food, good prices and friendly staff. I recommend ordering, you can find them on Glovo/bolt/wolt but also by phone directly to them (they also offer you a bonus dessert with a minimum order) 🍕🍝
Very good, tasty and quality food. I've been eating at their place for many years and they've never disappointed me. They always maintain the same level🤩
I recommend with confidence! Excellent food! Friendly staff! Fair prices for the quality offered!
Highly recommended restaurant. If you order through some apps and call them directly, you can customize your order if you want. Good quality food and friendly staff. 🍔🥗🍕🍳🥞❤️

Quiet place with good food and nice people! The staff was very friendly and the food was really tasty. My wife and i were full and decided to share their tiramisu which is homemade and looked so good that i forgot to take a picture and just enjoyed it ! Good place to spend a nice Sunday afternoon!

Still the best Italian food in the city, after more than 10 year being their client, great tastes, rich recipes, lovely atmosphere, personel going the extra-mile.  @the manager, please check the pipes, there was a funny smell :)

Lovely and cozy Italian restaurant. The pizza was better than average, but it didn't match my expectations for a Napolitaen pizza. However, the mussels with red sauce were really spectacular and  mouth-watering. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and I recommend this place!

The restaurant is located 3 km from the old town, so we took a cab to get there. We were welcomed by friendly staff, who spoke excellent English, and translated the menu to us. The restaurant is very nicely decorated and I found the intact tree in the center very beautiful.
The food was sadly not as good as we’d expected it to be. The pizzas lacked tomato sauce, the four cheese pizza was quite tasteless and the house wine was quite bland and disappointing. The pizza with Salami tasted better.
Not an authentic Italian experience but better than most places in Bucharest.
Great Italian food restaurant.  We had different main dishes, appetizers, and pizza.  They were all really well made and flavorful.  Service was welcoming, friendly, and fast.

Been here with a friend as he recently moved in the area. We were looking for a place to eat and found this location on Google maps. Had good reviews and rating, was nearby so we gave it a chance. Is a nice neighbourhood restaurant, with good food and big portions. Not pricy, no big pretentions and not for the ones who like a fancy location or gourmet food.
We had a couple tripe soups, then for second course I had sheep pastrami with polenta and garlic sauce with a side dish of pickles. He had half chicken.
Food was good, nothing special, is clearly not a gourmet location but one where you can eat and drink at a good price-quality ratio.
Drinks at a good price, service was also very good. Food comes quickly, so do the drinks.
All in all, we liked it and will come back if we get the chance.
Very nice place! The food was tasty and arrived quickly. The staff also very friendly.
Great food with very acceptable prices. I am a regular client and I highly recommend.

I was within Erasmus group there, it was awesome because everything was already :)). But the food is pretty great, the staff are extremely helpful and they also except guide dogs. They also had traditional Romanian live music. So we also got to dance before we had desert. Totally worth the visit.
Delicious food, good value and nice staff :)

The separation between the terrace (where people smoke) and the main restaurant isn't great, so you can feel the smoke inside.
The service was good and the food was nice (grilled shrimps and green mussels). The octopus wasn't great because it was way too chewy.

We got the Deep Fried combo for 2.  It’s really big 😅😅 and amazing. The seafood is frozen, but better quality. We were served by the owner who is very pleasant and cheerful. Music is good, generic bossa nova. Give it a go!

The waiter accidentally (or intentionally) touched a bottle on my table, the bottle fell and it spilled all over me, good that I catched it in time (or else the bottle would break into pieces on the floor). He didn't even apologize!! He just said "oops"! Get more delicate and respectful waiters!!
Great food, good place and nice people.
we got the titanic combo as we were with a group of friends, everything was so fresh and delicious and the platter was huge, will definitely come back :D
The service and food were great! My nephew rated the burger as the best he had! We liked a lot the ribs with wedges as well! We will definitely be back

The place has potential, the closed terrace was recently equipped with some interesting heating devices which look really great for a romantic dinner but they are a bit too smoggy for their first day. We chose the terrace because the inside was not airy and very cold at 11 AM.
The terrace is green, half plastic, half natural plants which are not well cared for.
The waiter was really friendly and nice, but he didn't hear the order well and he served us a single portion instead of two. We let it go, we were in a hurry, so we shared that one. We were the only clients in the restaurant, me and my teenage son.
The Schnitzels were tasty, the fried potatoes and salad average.
I understood the terrace is for smokers when the waiter smokes a cigar near us ... What a pity to smoke near a kid when the weather outside is excellent...
The food was good, i was satisfied with the taste and service
Nice place, tasty food, fast service, decent prices.
verry good

name: Erbario
address: Strada General Nicolae Haralambie 30, 040587 București, Romania

reviews.text:
This place is amazing
I tried their avocado toast and asked them to change the poached eggs with Halloumi cheese and they did. It tasted amazing. And the presentation of the food was also beautiful.

The interior was very beautiful too but you have to have a reservation previously to have a table inside.

The staff are friendly and they speak English too.

I really recommend the place
10/10

I came here multiple times, especially during summer, when I stayed on the terrace. This time, we went inside and I was pleasantly surprised by the decor and especially impressed with the architecture. The building is from 1930 and you can also see before and after pics, which is a nice thing since I am a huge fan of old buildings and their stories. About the coffee—yes, very tasty, I recommend two shots latte, perfect blend of coffee with milk.

Amazing food ❤️ the best coffee in Bucharest I’ve tried. Avocado salmon top was full of taste.
Make sure to make a reservation for the weekend as we had to sit outside and it was a bit chilly. But overall experience was great.

Food is very tasty, and it is not run of the mill, the recipes are fresh and exciting.
The coffee was quite a great experience, was not expecting to get a proper, well brewed cup, not burnt and fairly strong.
Lovely on the inside, but you'd best make a reservation, as seating is very limited, however the outside, while lacking the bohemeic atmosphere, has comfortable furniture and well placed tables.
You are not forgotten by the servers either and they are very nice and accommodating.

Quiet charming European ethnosphere , been here with family of 7 people and we really enjoyed this place

The food was simply perfect ! Every dish we all enjoyed
We have the engagement party on this lovely place 🎉🎉 Nice and professional staff

We organized a family wedding and 2 friends group gatherings in the big restaurant hall (capacity around 100 seats, plus some 50 seats in the small hall), plus we order take-away food weekly. The barbecue is really great, best Romanian minced meat balls (mici) I've ever had. Tasty food, wide variety of dishes (in the take-away salon especially by noon), large portions. Easy access by 323 bus, 25 or 7 tram or by car, 2 parking lots near-by (including the one on top of the Piata Progresul market)
Its was very nice
F ok
Ok

name: Ramore Fresh Food Soseau Viilor Sc 5

reviews.text:
Hands down the best burgers i ever had in my entire life!!!!!!

1-The buns are super super soft and tasty
2-The meatpatties have a crispy edge yet they melt in your mouth
3-The burgers are simple because the quality is insanely good
4-THEY ARE SERVED SUPER FAST
5-The Staff are so so friendly and nice even when its close to the end of their shift which means its a great place if you have happy employees.

I highly recommend going here and trying the double chese and the parm and garlic fries.

Also i dont usually post reviews even if i like a place or food but this one deserves all of my time for a review.

Ramirez is a breath of fresh air in the local food scene. Forget those mass-produced, rubbery patties – this place is all about fresh, quality ingredients and a genuine, neighborhood-friendly vibe. From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with a warm smile and the enticing aroma of sizzling burgers.
What truly sets the apart is their commitment to freshness. The patties are hand-formed daily, using locally sourced beef that tastes noticeably superior. You can taste the difference in every bite – juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The toppings are equally impressive, with crisp lettuce, ripe tomatoes, and tangy pickles that add the perfect crunch and zest.
Their menu is simple yet satisfying, offering a range of classic burgers with the option to customize with various cheeses, sauces, and add-ons. I opted for their signature "aBombardier cu ou” and it was a masterpiece of burger craftsmanship. The bun, a lightly toasted brioche, held its shape beautifully and complemented the savory patty. Beyond the food, the atmosphere is what makes the place a true neighborhood favorite. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, making you feel right at home. It's the kind of place where you can relax, enjoy a delicious meal, and have a casual chat with the owners or other patrons.The prices are reasonable, especially considering the quality of the ingredients and the generous portions. It’s a great value for a meal that leaves you feeling genuinely satisfied.It's more than just a burger place; it's a community hub where good food and good company come together. Highly recommended! P.S Acum lăsând vrăjeala , mi-a plăcut , bun , dar aveți grijă cu carnea din burger , a fost cam prea prăjită un fel de “very well done” .
Amazing quality fast service, hot and fresh food so so tasty.
Came for family event in Romania , but Ramores place became the event. Best food best staff! I will happily return !
tasty salsiccia burger and insane guanciale cheddar fries, quick service

Tasty food! I had a lasagna and it was exactly as I expected. From my experience, when it takes 40-50 minutes for your food to be served, for sure it's not a frozen casserole. Excellent atmosphere and a nice cozy space for us to spend it with our friends

Nice and cozy restaurant with friendly staff. The bathroom was very clean and the food was served pretty fast. The grilled chicken breast was juicy and well seasoned, same for the oven potatoes. Also, the asian beef was very good and the dark beer was awesome. They have different offers if you eat at the location on Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday or for groups on the week-end.

I'm a very complicated customer, some would even say I'm a Karen :)) but this place delivers more than expected. Great beef soup. Great chicken snitzel and great padron peppers. Also the sauce that comes with the chicken snitzel needs to be mentioned as tasting great. The prices are a bit high but okay compared to the rest of the city. Everywhere is way too expensive for the local economy. I recommend the place though as a returning customer.

Great atmosphere, awesome staff and great food.
Was my first time here, but definitely I will come back. Seems that I am not the only returning customer since everyone seems to know and like Isa 🤩.
All staff seems to be nice, but I am pretty sure she set some high standards for her colleagues since even the people on the table next to me are asking for her.
Seems too big of a coincidence if you ask me 😁. Looks like everyone knows her. Keep it up!
Prices are also decent, btw.

Very good food. Big portions and very tasteful.
This is the first time when we came and we will definitely return or order online. :)
Nice service, didn’t wait too much for the order and the prices are good for the quality of the food/services.
Recommand this place!
Hands down the best pizza in the Berceni area
Very good pizza. They also deliver in the area.
Very good pizza!! Fast delivery!
Great taste
Recommend pizza prosciutto and gorgonzola.

One of the best Turkish restaurant in Bucharest to enjoy authentic Turkish döner! I tried T bone steak and lamb shish. The meat is delicious, fresh, and always perfectly cooked. Portions are generous, the service is fast, and the staff are friendly and professional. The restaurant is clean and welcoming every time I visit. Highly recommended! 🇹🇷🥙🔥

We went on a monday evening about 10ish and it was very busy. There is two shops inside, one shop the que was by the front entrance and the second shop the que was about 6/7 people. We ordered chicken wings which come with rice salad and bread and chicken cubes again with rice salad and bread some chips which come in a box. We took our food away which was a shame as the food looked well presented when seating in.
The service was abit of a wait and they seemed friendly enough.

After 3 visits finally reviewing, and… it’s soo much protein 🫃

Jokes aside, very quick kebap joint, very clean and very filling. Best fresh (eat in), as takeaway can get soggy from the juices. Could easily be Halal but not in a Muslim country, or just not certified.
Simply the best steak in Bucharest by a mile. Fast service even when rammed with people

I tried the iskandar Kebab at this restaurant, and honestly, it was really delicious—worth every penny! I paid around 73 Li (roughly 16 EUR), and the quality justified the price. I loved it even more than their shawarma sandwich, which comes with salad and tomatoes. The restaurant is spacious, service is fast, and it’s conveniently close to both the metro and bus stations. Highly recommended!

Very good food, I would say a bit expensive, but it’s top quality, delicious and healthy. It’s created with a very good attention to details and it’s made to be savoured without hurry. And, of course, learn to use the chopsticks! It will enhance the experience and you’ll be proud of yourself. Probably nobody does it right the first time, but a little perseverance and some tips from the internet will help!

Amazing delivery experience! ZenSushi is by far the best sushi restaurant in town, and I am glad that the quality remains the same for the delivery option and their delivery service. Although it was a rainy day, the delivery was really fast, handled with care as well, and the sushi was just as fresh and delicious as it is for dining in. I hope in the future they will add Salmon Jyu bowls, their salmon is the best.
Good sushi, good prices, good staff. Been ordering for 3 yers, will keep ordering forever.

I live nearby and for me it’s my favorite sushi place. I often eat there, though it’s normally a takeaway place, but since you see directly how the cook is preparing the food I find it fascinating. The quality of the food is excellent. I wish they had some kind of retention for loyal customers.

Ordered takeaway from this place and delivery time was quite short so I’ll give them that. The first two rows of sushi rolls were delicious, but the last two didn’t have anything special. They just seemed mediocre to me, the taste combination of mango, mayo and salmon wasn’t my cup of tea, but that’s just my preference. Overall nice sushi, maybe I’ll order again, choosing other types of rolls this time.
Good service. Don't know anything about prices (was a baptism)
Super ok
Nice romanian musical band. Good local food.
Not a bad place in not a very good neighbourhood
Excellent, food, staff, location.

We found this place by recommendation and we are not disappointed.
Great food, especially Mici and please save some room for Papanasi - best in Bucharest!!!
Nice and friendly staff - not a common occurrence in Bucharest.
Enjoy!

Taverna la Călinescu welcomes you with a warm, nostalgic atmosphere and truly delicious food at affordable prices. The retro interior, filled with painted canvases of famous art and movie icons, gives the place a unique charm. A cozy gem where great taste, culture, and comfort come together!

If you are looking for a place to eat good food from the Romanian cuisine, be it traditional or more modern, this is the spot. The food was delicious, and the service was beyond expectations. The waiters really work to satisfy the clients' needs. We had the traditional Romanian dessert Papanași and it was impressive; we combined them, one with chocolate and one with sour cherry jam and cream. This would be a great place for eating out with the family and even small gatherings.

Poor food quality. The desert wasn't properly cooked  and the dough was raw inside. Large portions. The waiters were great, though. You can try the place to see if you like it...but I wasn't very happy with it.

Small local restaurant not in the tourist area. You feel like you get a real Romanian food experience.
The food was delicious, I had the stuff cabbage and papanasi. Make sure you are hungry if you choose this dessert. 👌

We came here for lunch on a Saturday. We chose the chicken salad and the chicken schnitzel and the veal schnitzel. Food was very good and both schnitzels were very crispy. Personnel was a bit cold and neutral, not smiling or anything close to that. Menu not available in English, we were not given plates for our salad. Quite disturbing that they wanted to take our plates as soon as we finished our meals. Pleasant atmosphere near the fountains and little river in the park.

Out door dining with a nice terrace and a good view. Very nice music. Tables clean. Friendly staff, greeted us and told us "bon appetite" when they served us food. In regards to the food, i will have to say that it was a very large portion and it was very tasty. Will surely comeback at another time.

We ate here today. The food is very good, I have a chicken burger and my partner a mix grill.  Both very very good. Also good service and atmosphere. I totally  recommend this restaurant. I found it by mistake on google and I will surely return.

L.E. The red house  wine is very good and we stayed for the dinner, we ate a pizza , it was delicious.

We were here for lunch. The food was very good. We had pasta with seafood and we really enjoyed it. The restaurant was almost empty, so the food was ready very quickly. They also have excellent non-alcoholic cocktails which we tried. Unfortunately, however, they do not have a menu in English and the staff speaks very poor English.

We ate here twice this month to try and see if we like the place. Overall is OK but high(er) prices and the salads are simply just rediculously expensive.

The seafood is nice but is made from frozen.. and the pizza is very mediocre with minimal ingredients/toppings and an average dough, not sure if is made fresh or from factory made. The Burger is  very tasty for sure.

The staff however is mixed, some know how to act professional and attentive and friendly, but others don't understand how the dress a table for new customers (No cutlery?🤔) And work without a smile and lack positive attitude.

I visited Toan’s on Iuliu Maniu and had a fantastic experience—it’s a flavorful gem for Vietnamese cuisine lovers. Located conveniently on the boulevard, it offers a cozy setting and a well-crafted menu.

I started with a bowl of Pho Bo, and it truly lived up to its reputation. The broth was aromatic and deeply flavorful, and the beef was tender—one reviewer even called it the “bowl of heaven”  ￼. Portion size was generous, with refreshing herbs and perfectly cooked rice noodles.

For something lighter, I tried the Bánh mì. Crunchy baguette, savory grilled pork, pickles, cilantro, and lemongrass came together in a delicious harmony—locals consider it “one of the best sandwiches in the world”  ￼.

I also sampled the spring rolls and seafood nuggets (deep‑fried shrimp wrapped in crispy potato), which were both tasty and well-seasoned, offering a nice textural contrast .

The staff was attentive and friendly, and the ambiance was calm—it felt more like a proper restaurant than fast food  ￼. Prices are fair for Bucharest, though slightly higher than some other locations—but the quality justifies it  ￼.

Overall, Toan’s on Iuliu Maniu delivers authentic, satisfying Vietnamese dishes with consistent flavor and a comfortable atmosphere. Highly recommended for pho, bánh mì, and more!

Pub 18 is the kind of friend who’s been around forever — the one with legendary stories, impeccable timing, and a habit of showing up with pizza and beer just when you need it. Officially documented since 1991, it proudly holds the title of Romania’s first pub, which basically makes it the cool leather‑jacket‑wearing grandfather of all pubs.

For 35 years, it has perfected the art of “friends, not clients,” a motto so deeply rooted in its culture that walking in feels like a reunion. There’s always a smile, a joke, and — naturally — a cat supervising operations. Because what is a truly iconic pub without an aloof, furry manager?

I first stepped inside 23 years ago, and I still drop by whenever I can. With a bit of luck (and good pizza), I hope to still be walking through that door 30 years from now.

Speaking of pizza: Pub 18 treats it with the seriousness of an engineering student defending their diploma project in the same campus. Wood‑fired ovens, fresh ingredients, dough made daily — it has been sustaining hungry students and nostalgic alumni for decades. And the beer? Always cold, always on tap, always on time.

Cheers to all my friends at Pub 18 — and a big hug. See you soon!

The menu is carefully curated, featuring both classic Romanian dishes and well-executed international options. Each dish stands out through fresh ingredients, balanced flavors, and beautiful presentation. The meat dishes are particularly impressive—tender, well-seasoned, and cooked to perfection—while the sides and sauces complement them harmoniously. Portions are generous without sacrificing finesse.

Service is another strong point of Restaurant Potcoava. The staff is professional, attentive, and genuinely polite, always ready to recommend dishes or pair them with the right wine. You never feel rushed, yet everything flows smoothly and naturally.

The restaurant’s elegant décor and calm ambiance make it an excellent choice for business meetings, family gatherings, or intimate evenings. Attention to detail can be felt everywhere, from table settings to overall cleanliness.

Overall, Restaurant Potcoava delivers consistency, quality, and a memorable culinary experience. It is a place you return to not only for the food, but for the complete atmosphere and the feeling of being truly well taken care of.
